/info/summary.text: API HTTPS vseh strežnikov Scacelith, uradnega in skupnostnih.

/info/description.en:
Every Scacelith server, the official `caissa.scacelith.com` and any community server, answers this HTTPS API. The game uses it for everything outside a game itself: sign-up and sign-in (two-step verification and Google included), the account page, game history, PGN downloads and animated GIFs of games, signed-in devices, the data download, the deletion of the account, and reports.

Live play (matchmaking, challenges, moves, clocks) goes through the WebSocket of the same server (`wss://<host>/ws`), opened with a session token of this API; it is described in `PROTOCOL.md`, not here.

Defaults below are those of a server with an untouched configuration; a community server may change them (`CONFIG.md` names every setting).

## Base URL, port and transport

- Official server: `https://caissa.scacelith.com/api/v1`, TCP port 443.
- A community server: `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>[:<port>]/api/v1`. `API_PORT` is 443 by default; behind a NAT or a proxy, the port players use is `PUBLIC_API_PORT`.
- The game's WebSocket is on the same port by default (`WS_PORT` moves it; `GET /info` tells the client where it is).
- HTTP/1.1 over TLS. With `TLS_MODE=proxy`, a reverse proxy terminates TLS in front of the server. `TLS_MODE=off` (plain HTTP) is for local development only.
- The HTML pages opened from the links of e-mails (`/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/confirm-email-change`) live at the root of the server, outside `/api/v1`. The health endpoints answer both at the root and under `/api/v1`. Google sign-in has no page on the server: Google sends the browser back to the game itself, on `127.0.0.1`, or to a page of the website that started it (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`).
- A trailing slash is ignored (`/api/v1/info/` is `/api/v1/info`), and path parameters are URL-decoded (a parameter that is not valid URL encoding answers 400 `invalid_request`).

## Requests

- **JSON bodies.** `POST`, `PUT` and `DELETE` requests carry a JSON object with `Content-Type: application/json`. A `charset` other than UTF-8 is refused, and so is any other content type (415 `unsupported_media_type`). An empty body counts as `{}`, which is what the endpoints without parameters take (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`).
- **Size and time.** A body is limited to `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` bytes (16,384 by default; `POST /gif` has its own limit of 135,168 bytes): 413 `payload_too_large`. It must arrive within 10 seconds: 408 `request_timeout`. After either error the server closes the connection.
- **Strict schemas.** A field that the endpoint does not know is refused, a field not marked optional is required, and types and lengths are checked. Any of these failures answers 400 `invalid_request`, with `field` naming the field (dotted for a nested one, such as `pow.nonce`). Strings may not contain control characters. Lengths count UTF-16 code units, so a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (an emoji) counts twice. A body that is not JSON answers 400 `invalid_json`. `POST /gif` and `POST /reports` check their bodies themselves (see each endpoint).
- **Query strings.** The first occurrence of a parameter counts, unknown parameters are ignored, and a `+` decodes to a space: the endpoints that take a time-control category accept both `3%2B2` and `3+2`.
- **Methods.** `HEAD` is `GET` without the body. `OPTIONS` on an existing path answers 204 with an `Allow` header (and the headers of a CORS preflight, below). Any other method that the path does not have answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow`.
- **Request target.** It may not exceed 4096 characters (414 `uri_too_long`). A request that cannot be parsed at all, or whose head is too large or arrives too slowly, gets an empty 400, 431 or 408 answer and the connection is closed.
- **CORS: an allow-list, off by default.** The API serves the game, which sends no `Origin`. With `CORS_ORIGINS` empty (the default) no `Access-Control-*` header is ever sent, so no web page can read an answer. `CORS_ORIGINS` lists the web origins whose pages may call the API from a browser, each exactly as browsers send it in `Origin`: `https://host` or `https://host:port`, in lower case, without a path, a trailing slash or the default port; `http://` only for `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` (local development); no wildcard. The official server sets `CORS_ORIGINS=https://scacelith.com,https://www.scacelith.com` for its website. Then:
  - Every answer for a path under `/api/v1` but the health endpoints, successes and errors alike (the 429 of the per-address layer included), carries `Vary: Origin`. When the request's `Origin` is byte for byte one of the listed origins, it also carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <that origin>` and, except on the answer to a preflight, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After, Content-Disposition`, so that the page reads the error codes, `Retry-After` and the file names of the PGN and GIF downloads.
  - A preflight (`OPTIONS` with `Access-Control-Request-Method`) from a listed origin on an existing path answers 204, without a body, with `Allow`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` (the methods of `Allow`), `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600` and `Vary: Origin`. It needs no token and counts toward no account budget and no endpoint limit; like any request, it takes a token of the per-address layer. A browser reuses a preflight for 10 minutes, but only for that exact URL, query string included. A request without `Authorization` and without a JSON body, such as `GET /info` or `GET /leaderboard`, needs no preflight.
  - Any other answer to a preflight is a failed preflight, even with the CORS headers: a 404 for a path that does not exist, or the 429 of the per-address layer. The browser then does not send the request, and the page sees a network error, without the answer or its `Retry-After`.
  - `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` is never sent, nor `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`: a page sends its session token in `Authorization: Bearer`, as the game does, and the API sets no cookie. The HTML pages, the health endpoints and the empty answers to unreadable requests carry no CORS header. The WebSocket does not use CORS: `WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` lists the pages that may open it.
  - A page of an origin that is not listed reads nothing, and its cross-site writes are never sent: JSON bodies and `Authorization` need a preflight, whose answer has no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` for that origin. `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` stays on every answer: it applies only to `no-cors` requests (another site embedding an answer), never to the `cors` requests of a listed page.

## Answers and errors

- Answers are JSON in UTF-8, except the PGN download (`application/x-chess-pgn`), the animated GIFs (`image/gif`) and the HTML pages. Times are milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. Ids are integers. Game ids have up to 16 digits but stay below 2^53, so a JSON number (a double) holds them exactly.
- Every answer of the API carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` and `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` (the HTML pages have a policy of their own). With `TLS_MODE=native` it also carries `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. The answers that the listener writes itself, before the API (the `GET` and `HEAD` of the health endpoints, the 429 of the per-address layer, and a 500 `internal_error` when the API fails outright), carry the same headers except `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, and their `Content-Type` is `application/json` without a charset.
- An answer must be read within 60 seconds of the moment the server has it ready, which only matters for the large ones (a GIF, the data export, a long PGN). The time the server takes to prepare an answer counts neither toward this nor toward the 30 seconds without a byte in or out after which a connection is closed.

Errors have one shape (the `Error` schema):

```json
{ "error": "snake_case_code", "message": "An English sentence.", "retryAfter": 30 }
```

`message` is meant for logs and as a fallback; a client chooses what to show from `error`. `retryAfter` (seconds) is present only on refusals that end with time, and the answer then also carries a `Retry-After` header with the same value; the one exception is the 503 `busy` of the history, game, player and leaderboard reads, which has only the field. Some errors add fields: `field` (invalid input), `reason` (`weak_password`, `pow_required`), `pow` (`pow_required`), `until` (`banned`), `line` and `column` (`invalid_pgn`).

Errors that any endpoint can give:

| Status | `error` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | The body breaks the endpoint's schema (`field` says where), the request target or `Content-Length` is malformed, a path parameter is not valid URL encoding, or the body was cut off. |
| 400 | `invalid_json` | The body is not JSON. |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | No `Authorization` header on an endpoint that needs a session. |
| 401 | `invalid_token` | The token is malformed, expired, revoked or belongs to a deleted account; also on endpoints where the session is optional. |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such endpoint. Some endpoints also use it: no such game, player or session. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | The path exists for other methods (see `Allow`). |
| 408 | `request_timeout` | The body did not arrive within 10 seconds. |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | The body exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (135,168 bytes for `POST /gif`). |
| 414 | `uri_too_long` | The request target exceeds 4096 characters. |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | The body is not `application/json`, or its charset is not UTF-8. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | A rate limit (see below): `retryAfter` plus a `Retry-After` header. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | An unexpected failure. The server logs it. |
| 503 | `timeout` | The server did not answer within 30 seconds (60 seconds for the export, 45 seconds for the GIFs with the default settings). |
| 503 | `server_busy` | A session lookup or an account change found the database locked (`retryAfter` 1), or the password hash queue is full (see below). Also, with a `retryAfter` of 2 to 5, when the server is far behind: for a `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`, the database has too many writes waiting; for any request, too many earlier requests are still running past their timeout, or the session token could not be checked within 5 seconds. The request was not run, and its rate limits took nothing. |

The read endpoints (game history, games, players, leaderboard) and the export answer 503 `busy` with `retryAfter: 1` when the database stayed locked.

Endpoints that check or hash a password can also answer one of these, both with a random `retryAfter` of 5 to 15 seconds:

- 503 `server_busy`: the server's password hash queue (`PASSWORD_HASH_QUEUE_MAX`) is full, or the wait ran out.
- 429 `rate_limited`: once the queue is half full, this client (an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /48) already has `PASSWORD_HASH_WAITERS_PER_SOURCE` hashes waiting. This 429 gives back the rate-limit tokens that the request took.

Nothing was changed and no failed attempt was counted (except on `POST /auth/sso/google/link`, whose ticket try and account failure were taken before the hash), and a reset link stays valid.

The HTML pages answer their errors as HTML pages with the same status codes.

## Authentication

The endpoints that need a session take a bearer token in the `Authorization` header (the `bearerAuth` scheme):

```
Authorization: Bearer sct_L_8GDd7uzfQ3QQWtqrsWXDTsFWzRwIvJcwIGHhjWPS8
```

- **Getting a token.** A token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) comes from `POST /auth/login`, then `POST /auth/login/mfa` when two-step verification is on, from `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` and `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (Google sign-in), and from `POST /auth/sso/complete`. Every one of them answers `{ token, expiresAt, user }`. The server stores only a SHA-256 of the token.
- **Required session.** A missing header answers 401 `unauthorized` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith"`. An invalid token answers 401 `invalid_token` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith", error="invalid_token"`. A client should forget a token that gets `invalid_token` and sign in again.
- **Optional session.** On `GET /games/{id}`, `GET /games/{id}/pgn`, `GET /players/{username}` and `GET /players/{username}/games` the session is optional. Without the header they answer the public view; if a header is sent, its token must be valid.
- **Busy store.** When the database stays locked while a token is checked, an endpoint that requires or accepts a session answers 503 `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1` (and `Retry-After`); when the check takes more than 5 seconds, it answers 503 `server_busy` with a `retryAfter` of 2 to 5. Either way the token was not judged: keep it and send the request again.
- **Lifetime.** A session ends at the first of `SESSION_MAX_DAYS` (90) after the sign-in (this is `expiresAt`) and `SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` (30) without use. Each use pushes the idle limit back; the server writes the new value at most every 5 minutes, in the background. While its database has many writes waiting it postpones that write to a later request, except within the last hour before the idle limit, so a session in use does not expire. An account keeps at most `MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER` (10) sessions: a new sign-in revokes the oldest beyond that number.
- **Revocation.** Signing out (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`) revokes sessions; so do a password change (the other sessions), a password reset and the deletion of the account (every session), and an administrator. A revocation from the API takes effect at once, and the WebSocket opened with a revoked session is closed. A password change or reset and the deletion of the account revoke in the same transaction as the change itself: when one of them fails, no session was revoked and nothing else changed either. The server caches session lookups for 30 seconds, so a revocation by the admin command, a separate process, takes effect within 30 seconds.
- **Scope.** A token belongs to one server and opens its WebSocket too. Never send it to another server.

## Rate limits and other throttles

Limits apply to one of two scopes. **Client:** an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /64 (in proxy mode, the address comes from `X-Forwarded-For` sent by a `TRUSTED_PROXIES` address); some limits also count each IPv6 /48 as a whole, on top of each of its /64 networks. **Player:** the signed-in account, whatever its address; a limit counted per player on an endpoint where the session is optional counts per client for a request without a token.

Each limit is a token bucket that holds `limit` requests and refills continuously at `limit / window`; `retryAfter` is the time until the next token. Limits marked *shared* are also counted over a sliding window of the same length, so that no window holds much more than `limit` requests. Every limit is counted for the whole server. When one of an endpoint's limits refuses a request, the tokens that its other limits took for that request are given back. A refusal answers 429 `rate_limited` with `retryAfter` and `Retry-After`.

- **Per-address layer.** Every request (any path and method, the health endpoints and WebSocket upgrades included) first takes one token of its client's budget: `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP` (600) per minute with a burst of half a minute, and `HTTP_RATE_PER_PREFIX` (4 x `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP`) for an IPv6 /48. A client may also have at most `IP_MAX_INFLIGHT` (32 x `WORKERS`) requests in progress (`retryAfter` 1 beyond). A client that keeps going after its refusals is blocked: `ABUSE_BLOCK_REFUSALS_PER_MIN` (600) refusals in one minute block it for 1 minute, then 4, 16 and 60 minutes at each new block within 6 hours. A refusal of the `auth`, `auth_*` and `reauth` limits counts 5; limits counted per player never count. Addresses in `ABUSE_EXEMPT` skip this layer, but not the account budget or the endpoint limits.
- **Account budget.** Every request that carries a valid session token also counts against its account: `USER_RATE_PER_MIN` (120) per minute for all endpoints together, whatever the address, with a burst of half a minute.

`GET /info` and `GET /leaderboard` have no limit of their own: only the per-address layer. An endpoint with several limits checks them in the order given in its description.

The server handles a request in this order: the per-address layer, then the health endpoints; endpoint match; the checks that the server is not far behind (503 `server_busy`): too many earlier requests still running past their timeout and, for a `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`, the database's write backlog; authentication, within 5 seconds (503 `server_busy` beyond); the account budget, when the request carries a session; the endpoint's limits; the body; the endpoint itself (the GIF endpoints take their render limits only when they have a GIF to make). So a request refused for its token spends none of the endpoint's tokens, and a request with an invalid body does spend them.

Other throttles, answered by the endpoints themselves:

- **Failed sign-ins on one login name** (user name or e-mail): from `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) failures on, each attempt must wait twice as long as the one before (2 s, 4 s, and so on, up to 15 minutes): 429 `too_many_attempts` with `retryAfter`. The counter forgets after an hour without failures.
- **Failed second factors at sign-in:** the same rule from the 5th wrong code of the account. One sign-in step accepts at most 5 wrong codes.
- **Second-factor codes of one account:** at most `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) codes (authenticator or recovery codes, right or wrong) per 15 minutes, from any address, at sign-in and in re-authentications; beyond it 429 `too_many_attempts` before the code is checked, so a recovery code is not used up.
- **Failed re-authentications of an account** (wrong password or code): the same rule (429 `too_many_attempts`), shared by every endpoint that re-authenticates.
- **E-mails:** one confirmation or reset mail per address every 5 minutes (the answer stays the same); one "someone tried to use your address" notice per address per hour.
- **Reports:** `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) per player in 24 hours: 429 `report_limit`.

## Proof of work

`POST /auth/register` always needs a proof of work when `POW_REGISTER_BITS` is above 0 (18 by default; `GET /info` gives it as `pow.register`). `POST /auth/login` and `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (one kind of challenge for both) need one only for 5 minutes after the server sees a wave of failed sign-ins (`POW_LOGIN_TRIGGER_PER_MIN`, then `POW_LOGIN_BITS`); a client finds out from the answer.

1. The request without a proof (or with a refused one) answers 428 `pow_required` with `reason` and a `pow` challenge `{ challenge, bits, expiresAt }`.
2. Find a nonce: a decimal string of at most 20 digits such that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` starts with `bits` zero bits (most significant bit of the first byte first). 18 bits take about 260,000 hashes on average.
3. Send the same request again with `"pow": { "challenge": "...", "nonce": "123456" }` in the body.

A challenge is valid for 2 minutes and only once, for one endpoint and one client network (an IPv4 address or IPv6 /64). It is signed, so the server keeps nothing about it until it comes back. `reason` says why a proof was refused: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.

## Re-authentication

Account changes ask for the password again and, when two-step verification is on, for a second factor:

- the password only: `POST /account/password` and `POST /account/mfa/totp/setup`;
- the password and an authenticator code, a recovery code being refused: `POST /account/mfa/recovery-codes`;
- the password and an authenticator code or a recovery code: `POST /account/mfa/totp/disable`, `POST /account/email`, `POST /account/export` and `POST /account/delete`.

In bodies, `code` holds a 6-digit authenticator code and `recoveryCode` a recovery code (`xxxx-xxxx-xx`; case, spaces and dashes do not matter). A recovery code may also be sent in `code` where recovery codes are accepted. Each code works once: a used authenticator code is refused until the next 30-second step, and a recovery code is gone once it is used.

| Status | `error` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | `invalid_password` | Wrong password, or the password was reset or changed while the request ran (nothing was changed). |
| 403 | `mfa_code_required` | Two-step verification is on and neither `code` nor `recoveryCode` was sent. |
| 403 | `invalid_code` | Wrong or already used code. |
| 400 | `password_not_set` | A Google-only account has no password yet ("Forgot password" sets one). |
| 429 | `too_many_attempts` | Too many failures, or too many codes tried, on this account. |
| 503 / 429 | `server_busy` / `rate_limited` | The password hash queue is busy. |

Failed passwords and codes count in the account's failure counter and are recorded as security events.

## Metrics port

Besides the API port, the server answers plain HTTP on the metrics port (`METRICS_PORT`, 9464, bound to `METRICS_BIND`, 127.0.0.1 by default; keep it private). It is not part of this API: `GET /healthz` answers `ok`; `GET /readyz` answers `ready` once the start-up is complete (every shard has replayed its journal and the listeners are bound) and until the shutdown begins, else 503 `not ready`; `GET /metrics` serves the Prometheus metrics and, with `METRICS_TOKEN` set, needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with that exact token.
/info/description.text:
Vsak strežnik Scacelith, tako uradni `caissa.scacelith.com` kot vsak skupnostni strežnik, podpira ta API HTTPS. Igra ga uporablja za vse, kar ni sama partija: registracijo in prijavo (vključno z dvofaktorskim preverjanjem pristnosti in prijavo z Googlom), stran računa, zgodovino partij, prenose PGN in animirane GIF-e partij, prijavljene naprave, prenos podatkov, izbris računa in prijave kršitev.

Igra v živo (iskanje nasprotnika, izzivi, poteze, ure) poteka prek WebSocketa istega strežnika (`wss://<host>/ws`), ki se odpre z žetonom seje tega API-ja; opisana je v `PROTOCOL.md`, ne tukaj.

Spodaj navedene privzete vrednosti so vrednosti strežnika z nespremenjeno konfiguracijo; skupnostni strežnik jih lahko spremeni (`CONFIG.md` navaja vse nastavitve).

## Osnovni URL, vrata in prenos

- Uradni strežnik: `https://caissa.scacelith.com/api/v1`, vrata TCP 443.
- Skupnostni strežnik: `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>[:<port>]/api/v1`. `API_PORT` je privzeto 443; za NAT-om ali posredniškim strežnikom (proxy) so vrata, ki jih uporabljajo igralci, `PUBLIC_API_PORT`.
- WebSocket igre je privzeto na istih vratih (`WS_PORT` ga premakne; `GET /info` odjemalcu pove, kje je).
- HTTP/1.1 prek TLS. Pri `TLS_MODE=proxy` TLS zaključuje obratni posredniški strežnik pred strežnikom. `TLS_MODE=off` (navaden HTTP) je samo za lokalni razvoj.
- Strani HTML, ki se odprejo s povezavami v e-poštnih sporočilih (`/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/confirm-email-change`), so v korenu strežnika, zunaj `/api/v1`. Končne točke za preverjanje stanja odgovarjajo tako v korenu kot pod `/api/v1`. Prijava z Googlom na strežniku nima nobene strani: Google brskalnik preusmeri nazaj v samo igro, na `127.0.0.1`, ali na stran spletnega mesta, ki je prijavo začelo (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`).
- Končna poševnica se ne upošteva (`/api/v1/info/` je `/api/v1/info`), parametri poti pa se dekodirajo iz kodiranja URL (na parameter, ki ni veljavno kodiran za URL, je odgovor 400 `invalid_request`).

## Zahteve

- **Telesa JSON.** Zahteve `POST`, `PUT` in `DELETE` vsebujejo objekt JSON z `Content-Type: application/json`. `charset`, ki ni UTF-8, je zavrnjen, prav tako vsaka druga vrsta vsebine (415 `unsupported_media_type`). Prazno telo šteje kot `{}`, kar sprejemajo končne točke brez parametrov (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`).
- **Velikost in čas.** Telo je omejeno na `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` bajtov (privzeto 16.384; `POST /gif` ima lastno omejitev 135.168 bajtov): 413 `payload_too_large`. Prispeti mora v 10 sekundah: 408 `request_timeout`. Po kateri koli od teh dveh napak strežnik zapre povezavo.
- **Stroge sheme.** Polje, ki ga končna točka ne pozna, je zavrnjeno, polje, ki ni označeno kot neobvezno, je obvezno, preverjajo pa se tudi vrste in dolžine. Odgovor na vsako od teh napak je 400 `invalid_request`, pri čemer `field` navede polje (za gnezdeno polje s pikami, na primer `pow.nonce`). Nizi ne smejo vsebovati kontrolnih znakov. Dolžine se štejejo v kodnih enotah UTF-16, zato znak zunaj osnovne večjezične ravnine (emoji) šteje dvakrat. Odgovor na telo, ki ni JSON, je 400 `invalid_json`. `POST /gif` in `POST /reports` svoja telesa preverjata sama (glejte posamezno končno točko).
- **Poizvedbeni nizi.** Šteje prva pojavitev parametra, neznani parametri se ne upoštevajo, `+` pa se dekodira v presledek: končne točke, ki sprejemajo kategorijo tempa igre, sprejmejo tako `3%2B2` kot `3+2`.
- **Metode.** `HEAD` je `GET` brez telesa. `OPTIONS` na obstoječi poti odgovori 204 z glavo `Allow` (in glavami zahteve preflight CORS, glejte spodaj). Na vsako drugo metodo, ki je pot nima, je odgovor 405 `method_not_allowed` z `Allow`.
- **Cilj zahteve.** Ne sme presegati 4096 znakov (414 `uri_too_long`). Zahteva, ki je sploh ni mogoče razčleniti ali katere glava je prevelika ali prispe prepočasi, dobi prazen odgovor 400, 431 ali 408, povezava pa se zapre.
- **CORS: seznam dovoljenih, privzeto izklopljen.** API streže igri, ki ne pošilja `Origin`. Ko je `CORS_ORIGINS` prazen (privzeto), se nikoli ne pošlje nobena glava `Access-Control-*`, zato nobena spletna stran ne more prebrati odgovora. `CORS_ORIGINS` navaja spletne izvore, katerih strani lahko kličejo API iz brskalnika, vsakega natanko tako, kot ga brskalniki pošljejo v `Origin`: `https://host` ali `https://host:port`, z malimi črkami, brez poti, končne poševnice ali privzetih vrat; `http://` samo za `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` in `[::1]` (lokalni razvoj); brez nadomestnih znakov. Uradni strežnik za svoje spletno mesto nastavi `CORS_ORIGINS=https://scacelith.com,https://www.scacelith.com`. Takrat:
  - Vsak odgovor za pot pod `/api/v1`, razen končnih točk za preverjanje stanja, tako uspešen kot z napako (vključno z 429 sloja po naslovu), vsebuje `Vary: Origin`. Kadar je `Origin` zahteve bajt za bajtom enak enemu od navedenih izvorov, vsebuje tudi `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <that origin>` in, razen v odgovoru na zahtevo preflight, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After, Content-Disposition`, tako da stran lahko prebere kode napak, `Retry-After` in imena datotek prenosov PGN in GIF.
  - Na zahtevo preflight (`OPTIONS` z `Access-Control-Request-Method`) z navedenega izvora na obstoječi poti je odgovor 204, brez telesa, z `Allow`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` (metode iz `Allow`), `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600` in `Vary: Origin`. Ne potrebuje žetona seje in se ne šteje v nobeno kvoto računa niti v nobeno omejitev končne točke; kot vsaka zahteva porabi žeton sloja po naslovu. Brskalnik zahtevo preflight znova uporablja 10 minut, vendar samo za točno ta URL, vključno s poizvedbenim nizom. Zahteva brez `Authorization` in brez telesa JSON, na primer `GET /info` ali `GET /leaderboard`, ne potrebuje zahteve preflight.
  - Vsak drug odgovor na zahtevo preflight pomeni neuspelo zahtevo preflight, tudi z glavami CORS: 404 za pot, ki ne obstaja, ali 429 sloja po naslovu. Brskalnik takrat zahteve ne pošlje, stran pa vidi omrežno napako, brez odgovora in njegovega `Retry-After`.
  - `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` se nikoli ne pošlje, prav tako ne `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`: stran pošlje svoj žeton seje v `Authorization: Bearer`, tako kot igra, API pa ne nastavlja piškotkov. Strani HTML, končne točke za preverjanje stanja in prazni odgovori na neberljive zahteve nimajo nobene glave CORS. WebSocket ne uporablja CORS: `WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` navaja strani, ki ga smejo odpreti.
  - Stran z izvora, ki ni naveden, ne prebere ničesar, njene zahteve za pisanje z drugega spletnega mesta pa se nikoli ne pošljejo: telesa JSON in `Authorization` potrebujejo zahtevo preflight, katere odgovor za ta izvor nima `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` ostane na vsakem odgovoru: velja samo za zahteve `no-cors` (drugo spletno mesto vdela odgovor), nikoli za zahteve `cors` navedene strani.

## Odgovori in napake

- Odgovori so JSON v UTF-8, razen prenosa PGN (`application/x-chess-pgn`), animiranih GIF-ov (`image/gif`) in strani HTML. Časi so v milisekundah od 1970-01-01 UTC. ID-ji so cela števila. ID-ji partij imajo do 16 števk, vendar ostanejo pod 2^53, zato jih število JSON (double) zapiše natančno.
- Vsak odgovor API-ja vsebuje `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` in `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` (strani HTML imajo lasten pravilnik). Pri `TLS_MODE=native` vsebuje tudi `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. Odgovori, ki jih poslušalec zapiše sam, pred API-jem (`GET` in `HEAD` končnih točk za preverjanje stanja, 429 sloja po naslovu in 500 `internal_error`, kadar API v celoti odpove), vsebujejo enake glave razen `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, njihov `Content-Type` pa je `application/json` brez nabora znakov.
- Odgovor mora biti prebran v 60 sekundah od trenutka, ko ga ima strežnik pripravljenega, kar je pomembno samo pri velikih odgovorih (GIF, izvoz podatkov, dolg PGN). Čas, ki ga strežnik porabi za pripravo odgovora, se ne šteje ne v ta rok ne v 30 sekund brez prejetega ali poslanega bajta, po katerih se povezava zapre.

Napake imajo enotno obliko (shema `Error`):

```json
{ "error": "snake_case_code", "message": "An English sentence.", "retryAfter": 30 }
```

`message` je namenjen dnevnikom in kot nadomestna možnost; odjemalec izbere, kaj prikaže, glede na `error`. `retryAfter` (v sekundah) je prisoten samo pri zavrnitvah, ki s časom prenehajo, odgovor pa takrat vsebuje tudi glavo `Retry-After` z isto vrednostjo; edina izjema je 503 `busy` pri branju zgodovine, partij, igralcev in lestvice, ki ima samo polje. Nekatere napake dodajo polja: `field` (neveljaven vnos), `reason` (`weak_password`, `pow_required`), `pow` (`pow_required`), `until` (`banned`), `line` in `column` (`invalid_pgn`).

Napake, ki jih lahko vrne katera koli končna točka:

| Status | `error` | Kdaj |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | Telo krši shemo končne točke (`field` pove, kje), cilj zahteve ali `Content-Length` je napačno oblikovan, parameter poti ni veljavno kodiran za URL ali pa je bilo telo odrezano. |
| 400 | `invalid_json` | Telo ni JSON. |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | Pri končni točki, ki zahteva sejo, ni glave `Authorization`. |
| 401 | `invalid_token` | Žeton je napačno oblikovan, potekel, preklican ali pripada izbrisanemu računu; tudi pri končnih točkah, kjer je seja neobvezna. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Te končne točke ni. To kodo uporabljajo tudi nekatere končne točke: partija, igralec ali seja ne obstaja. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | Pot obstaja za druge metode (glejte `Allow`). |
| 408 | `request_timeout` | Telo ni prispelo v 10 sekundah. |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | Telo presega `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (135.168 bajtov za `POST /gif`). |
| 414 | `uri_too_long` | Cilj zahteve presega 4096 znakov. |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | Telo ni `application/json` ali njegov nabor znakov ni UTF-8. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Omejitev števila zahtev (glejte spodaj): `retryAfter` in glava `Retry-After`. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | Nepričakovana napaka. Strežnik jo zapiše v dnevnik. |
| 503 | `timeout` | Strežnik ni odgovoril v 30 sekundah (60 sekund za izvoz, 45 sekund za GIF-e pri privzetih nastavitvah). |
| 503 | `server_busy` | Iskanje seje ali sprememba računa je naletela na zaklenjeno zbirko podatkov (`retryAfter` 1) ali pa je čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel polna (glejte spodaj). Tudi z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja: pri `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` ali `DELETE` v zbirki podatkov čaka preveč zapisovanj; pri kateri koli zahtevi se preveč prejšnjih zahtev še vedno izvaja po poteku časa za obdelavo zahteve ali pa žetona seje ni bilo mogoče preveriti v 5 sekundah. Zahteva ni bila izvedena in njene omejitve števila zahtev niso porabile ničesar. |

Končne točke za branje (zgodovina partij, partije, igralci, lestvica) in izvoz odgovorijo 503 `busy` z `retryAfter: 1`, kadar je zbirka podatkov ostala zaklenjena.

Končne točke, ki preverjajo ali zgoščujejo geslo, lahko odgovorijo tudi z eno od teh napak, obe z naključnim `retryAfter` od 5 do 15 sekund:

- 503 `server_busy`: strežnikova čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel (`PASSWORD_HASH_QUEUE_MAX`) je polna ali pa se je čakanje izteklo.
- 429 `rate_limited`: ko je čakalna vrsta napol polna, ima ta odjemalec (naslov IPv4 ali IPv6 /48) že `PASSWORD_HASH_WAITERS_PER_SOURCE` zgoščevanj na čakanju. Ta 429 vrne žetone omejitev števila zahtev, ki jih je zahteva porabila.

Nič ni bilo spremenjeno in noben neuspel poskus ni bil štet (razen pri `POST /auth/sso/google/link`, kjer sta bila poskus vstopnice in neuspeh računa šteta že pred zgoščevanjem), povezava za ponastavitev gesla pa ostane veljavna.

Strani HTML svoje napake vrnejo kot strani HTML z istimi statusnimi kodami.

## Preverjanje pristnosti

Končne točke, ki zahtevajo sejo, sprejmejo nosilni žeton (bearer) v glavi `Authorization` (shema `bearerAuth`):

```
Authorization: Bearer sct_L_8GDd7uzfQ3QQWtqrsWXDTsFWzRwIvJcwIGHhjWPS8
```

- **Pridobitev žetona.** Žeton (`sct_`, ki mu sledi 43 znakov base64url) vrne `POST /auth/login`, nato `POST /auth/login/mfa`, kadar je dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti vklopljeno, vrnejo pa ga tudi `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` in `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (prijava z Googlom) ter `POST /auth/sso/complete`. Vse te končne točke odgovorijo z `{ token, expiresAt, user }`. Strežnik hrani samo SHA-256 žetona.
- **Obvezna seja.** Na manjkajočo glavo je odgovor 401 `unauthorized` z `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith"`. Na neveljaven žeton je odgovor 401 `invalid_token` z `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith", error="invalid_token"`. Odjemalec naj pozabi žeton, ki dobi `invalid_token`, in se znova prijavi.
- **Neobvezna seja.** Pri `GET /games/{id}`, `GET /games/{id}/pgn`, `GET /players/{username}` in `GET /players/{username}/games` je seja neobvezna. Brez glave vrnejo javni pogled; če je glava poslana, mora biti njen žeton veljaven.
- **Zasedena shramba.** Kadar zbirka podatkov med preverjanjem žetona ostane zaklenjena, končna točka, ki sejo zahteva ali sprejema, odgovori 503 `server_busy` z `retryAfter: 1` (in `Retry-After`); kadar preverjanje traja več kot 5 sekund, odgovori 503 `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5. V obeh primerih o žetonu ni bilo odločeno: obdržite ga in zahtevo pošljite znova.
- **Življenjska doba.** Seja se konča ob prvem od dveh rokov: `SESSION_MAX_DAYS` (90) dni po prijavi (to je `expiresAt`) ali `SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` (30) dni brez uporabe. Vsaka uporaba odmakne omejitev nedejavnosti; strežnik novo vrednost zapiše največ vsakih 5 minut, v ozadju. Dokler v njegovi zbirki podatkov čaka veliko zapisovanj, to zapisovanje odloži na poznejšo zahtevo, razen v zadnji uri pred iztekom omejitve nedejavnosti, tako da seja, ki je v uporabi, ne poteče. Račun ima lahko največ `MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER` (10) sej: nova prijava prekliče najstarejše seje nad tem številom.
- **Preklic.** Odjava (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`) prekliče seje; prav tako jih prekličejo sprememba gesla (druge seje), ponastavitev gesla in izbris računa (vse seje) ter skrbnik. Preklic prek API-ja začne veljati takoj, WebSocket, odprt s preklicano sejo, pa se zapre. Sprememba ali ponastavitev gesla in izbris računa seje prekličejo v isti transakciji kot samo spremembo: če ena od njih ne uspe, ni bila preklicana nobena seja in tudi nič drugega ni bilo spremenjeno. Strežnik rezultate iskanja sej predpomni 30 sekund, zato preklic s skrbniškim ukazom, ki je ločen proces, začne veljati v 30 sekundah.
- **Obseg.** Žeton pripada enemu strežniku in odpre tudi njegov WebSocket. Nikoli ga ne pošiljajte drugemu strežniku.

## Omejitve števila zahtev in druge omejitve

Omejitve veljajo za enega od dveh obsegov. **Odjemalec:** naslov IPv4 ali IPv6 /64 (v načinu proxy naslov izhaja iz `X-Forwarded-For`, ki ga pošlje naslov iz `TRUSTED_PROXIES`); nekatere omejitve poleg vsakega omrežja /64 štejejo tudi vsako omrežje IPv6 /48 kot celoto. **Igralec:** prijavljeni račun, ne glede na njegov naslov; omejitev, ki se šteje po igralcu, se pri končni točki z neobvezno sejo za zahtevo brez žetona šteje po odjemalcu.

Vsaka omejitev je vedro žetonov, ki sprejme `limit` zahtev in se neprekinjeno polni s hitrostjo `limit / window`; `retryAfter` je čas do naslednjega žetona. Omejitve, označene kot *deljene*, se štejejo tudi v drsnem oknu enake dolžine, tako da nobeno okno ne vsebuje bistveno več kot `limit` zahtev. Vsaka omejitev se šteje za celoten strežnik. Kadar ena od omejitev končne točke zavrne zahtevo, se žetoni, ki so jih za to zahtevo porabile njene druge omejitve, vrnejo. Odgovor na zavrnitev je 429 `rate_limited` z `retryAfter` in `Retry-After`.

- **Sloj po naslovu.** Vsaka zahteva (katera koli pot in metoda, vključno s končnimi točkami za preverjanje stanja in nadgradnjami na WebSocket) najprej porabi en žeton iz kvote svojega odjemalca: `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP` (600) na minuto z izbruhom (burst) za pol minute in `HTTP_RATE_PER_PREFIX` (4 x `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP`) za IPv6 /48. Odjemalec ima lahko tudi največ `IP_MAX_INFLIGHT` (32 x `WORKERS`) zahtev v obdelavi (nad tem `retryAfter` 1). Odjemalec, ki po zavrnitvah nadaljuje, je blokiran: `ABUSE_BLOCK_REFUSALS_PER_MIN` (600) zavrnitev v eni minuti ga blokira za 1 minuto, nato za 4, 16 in 60 minut ob vsaki novi blokadi v 6 urah. Zavrnitev omejitev `auth`, `auth_*` in `reauth` šteje 5; zavrnitve omejitev, ki se štejejo po igralcu, ne štejejo nikoli. Naslovi v `ABUSE_EXEMPT` ta sloj preskočijo, ne pa tudi kvote računa ali omejitev končnih točk.

Strežnik zahtevo obdela v tem vrstnem redu: sloj po naslovu, nato končne točke za preverjanje stanja; ujemanje končne točke; preverjanja, da strežnik ne zaostaja močno (503 `server_busy`): preveč prejšnjih zahtev se še izvaja po poteku časa za obdelavo zahteve in, pri `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` ali `DELETE`, zaostanek zapisovanj v zbirki podatkov; preverjanje pristnosti, v 5 sekundah (nad tem 503 `server_busy`); kvota računa, če zahteva vsebuje sejo; omejitve končne točke; telo; sama končna točka (končne točke za GIF-e porabijo svoje omejitve upodabljanja samo, kadar morajo GIF izdelati). Zahteva, zavrnjena zaradi svojega žetona seje, torej ne porabi nobenega žetona končne točke, zahteva z neveljavnim telesom pa jih porabi.

Druge omejitve, ki jih uveljavljajo končne točke same:

- **Neuspele prijave z istim prijavnim imenom** (uporabniško ime ali e-poštni naslov): od `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) neuspehov naprej mora vsak poskus čakati dvakrat dlje kot prejšnji (2 s, 4 s in tako naprej, do 15 minut): 429 `too_many_attempts` z `retryAfter`. Števec se ponastavi po eni uri brez neuspehov.
- **Neuspeli drugi faktorji pri prijavi:** enako pravilo od 5. napačne kode računa naprej. En korak prijave sprejme največ 5 napačnih kod.
- **Kode drugega faktorja posameznega računa:** največ `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) kod (iz aplikacije ali obnovitvenih, pravilnih ali napačnih) na 15 minut, s katerega koli naslova, pri prijavi in pri ponovnih preverjanjih pristnosti; nad tem 429 `too_many_attempts`, še preden se koda preveri, zato se obnovitvena koda ne porabi.
- **Neuspela ponovna preverjanja pristnosti računa** (napačno geslo ali koda): enako pravilo (429 `too_many_attempts`), skupno vsem končnim točkam, ki ponovno preverjajo pristnost.
- **E-poštna sporočila:** eno sporočilo za potrditev ali ponastavitev na naslov vsakih 5 minut (odgovor ostane enak); eno obvestilo »nekdo je poskusil uporabiti vaš naslov« na naslov na uro.
- **Prijave kršitev:** `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) na igralca v 24 urah: 429 `report_limit`.

## Dokaz o delu

`POST /auth/register` vedno zahteva dokaz o delu, kadar je `POW_REGISTER_BITS` večji od 0 (privzeto 18; `GET /info` ga vrne kot `pow.register`). `POST /auth/login` in `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (ena vrsta izziva za obe) ga zahtevata samo 5 minut po tem, ko strežnik zazna val neuspelih prijav (`POW_LOGIN_TRIGGER_PER_MIN`, nato `POW_LOGIN_BITS`); odjemalec to izve iz odgovora.

1. Odgovor na zahtevo brez dokaza (ali z zavrnjenim dokazom) je 428 `pow_required` z `reason` in izzivom `pow` `{ challenge, bits, expiresAt }`.
2. Poiščite nonce: decimalni niz z največ 20 števkami, pri katerem se `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` začne z `bits` ničelnimi biti (najprej najpomembnejši bit prvega bajta). Za 18 bitov je treba v povprečju izračunati približno 260.000 zgoščenih vrednosti.
3. Isto zahtevo pošljite znova z `"pow": { "challenge": "...", "nonce": "123456" }` v telesu.

Izziv velja 2 minuti in samo enkrat, za eno končno točko in eno omrežje odjemalca (naslov IPv4 ali IPv6 /64). Podpisan je, zato strežnik o njem ne hrani ničesar, dokler se ne vrne. `reason` pove, zakaj je bil dokaz zavrnjen: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` ali `replayed`.

## Ponovno preverjanje pristnosti

Spremembe računa znova zahtevajo geslo in, kadar je dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti vklopljeno, drugi faktor:

- samo geslo: `POST /account/password` in `POST /account/mfa/totp/setup`;
- geslo in kodo iz aplikacije, obnovitvena koda pa je zavrnjena: `POST /account/mfa/recovery-codes`;
- geslo in kodo iz aplikacije ali obnovitveno kodo: `POST /account/mfa/totp/disable`, `POST /account/email`, `POST /account/export` in `POST /account/delete`.

V telesih `code` vsebuje 6-mestno kodo iz aplikacije, `recoveryCode` pa obnovitveno kodo (`xxxx-xxxx-xx`; velike in male črke, presledki in vezaji niso pomembni). Obnovitveno kodo je mogoče poslati tudi v `code`, kjer so obnovitvene kode sprejete. Vsaka koda deluje enkrat: uporabljena koda iz aplikacije je zavrnjena do naslednjega 30-sekundnega koraka, obnovitvena koda pa po uporabi ne velja več.

| Status | `error` | Kdaj |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | `invalid_password` | Napačno geslo ali pa je bilo geslo med izvajanjem zahteve ponastavljeno ali spremenjeno (nič ni bilo spremenjeno). |
| 403 | `mfa_code_required` | Dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti je vklopljeno, poslana pa ni bila niti `code` niti `recoveryCode`. |
| 403 | `invalid_code` | Napačna ali že uporabljena koda. |
| 400 | `password_not_set` | Račun samo s prijavo z Googlom še nima gesla (»Pozabljeno geslo« ga nastavi). |
| 429 | `too_many_attempts` | Preveč neuspehov ali preveč preizkušenih kod pri tem računu. |
| 503 / 429 | `server_busy` / `rate_limited` | Čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel je zasedena. |

Napačna gesla in kode se štejejo v števec neuspehov računa in se zabeležijo kot varnostni dogodki.

## Vrata za metrike

Poleg vrat API strežnik na vratih za metrike odgovarja prek navadnega HTTP (`METRICS_PORT`, 9464, vezana na `METRICS_BIND`, privzeto 127.0.0.1; naj ostanejo zasebna). Niso del tega API-ja: `GET /healthz` odgovori `ok`; `GET /readyz` odgovori `ready`, ko je zagon končan (vsak shard je znova predvajal svoj dnevnik in poslušalci so vezani), in do začetka zaustavitve, sicer 503 `not ready`; `GET /metrics` streže metrike Prometheus in, če je nastavljen `METRICS_TOKEN`, zahteva `Authorization: Bearer <token>` s točno tem žetonom.

/tags/3/description.en:
Offered when `GET /info` says `sso.google: true`; otherwise every endpoint below answers 404 `sso_disabled`. A website signs in the same way with its own client when `sso.googleWeb` is true (below, **On a website**). The game signs in through the system browser with the installed-app flow of RFC 8252 (a "Desktop app" client): Google sends the browser back to a listener of the game on `127.0.0.1`, never to this server, and the game never sees a Google credential.

1. The client listens on `127.0.0.1:0` (the system picks the port) and makes a PKCE pair: a `codeVerifier` of 43 to 128 characters `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` and `codeChallenge = BASE64URL(SHA-256(codeVerifier))`, which has 43 characters and no padding.
2. `POST /auth/sso/google/start` with the challenge and the port returns the Google URL and the attempt's `state`. The client checks the URL (below) and opens it in the browser.
3. Google sends the browser to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth2/google/<tag>?code=...&state=...`. The client accepts only the `state` of the start answer, and sends nothing after an `error=` redirect.
4. `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` with the attempt id, the `codeVerifier`, the `state` and the `code` (and `iss` when Google sent it).
5. The answer is a session, a two-step verification step (continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`), `needsUsername` for a new player (continue with `POST /auth/sso/complete`), or `needsPassword` when an account with a password uses the address (continue with `POST /auth/sso/google/link`).

**The origin tag.** The redirect URI carries a tag of the server the player added, so that a URL another server got for its own players is refused by the game. The origin is the lower-case host (an IPv6 literal in brackets), `:` and the decimal API port, always written, 443 included: the server takes `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` and its public API port, the game the address it is connected to. The tag is the first 22 characters of the base64url (no padding) of SHA-256(UTF-8 `"scacelith-sso-origin-v1\n"` + origin). The redirect URI is `"http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/oauth2/google/" + tag`: always the IPv4 literal, and the port of the game's listener (1024 to 65535). The server never takes a URI, host or path from the client.

| Origin | Tag |
|---|---|
| `play.scacelith.example:443` | `IhcScoV7eDOzTEcSnqPUPt` |
| `localhost:8443` | `TFGx7zQ_8QlGZW5zpqznCr` |
| `[::1]:8443` | `XToJm0DG5PjciEVmZa9Cho` |
| `127.0.0.1:50443` | `3r653wM5ZjYsHcAJljmCwY` |

So Google sign-in works only for players who added the server under exactly `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` and its public API port.

**What the game checks before it opens the browser.** The `authUrl` starts with exactly `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?` and is printable ASCII under 4096 characters, and its query has exactly one `response_type=code`, exactly one `redirect_uri` equal to the URI the game computes from its port and its origin tag, exactly one `state` equal to the answer's `state`, `code_challenge_method=S256` and a 43-character `code_challenge`. Otherwise the game stops its listener and opens nothing. It posts `finish` and `link` only to the server that answered `start`.

**On a website.** A website (the official one: <https://scacelith.com/>) signs in with a "Web application" client of the same Google project (`GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID`). Google sends the browser back to one page of the site that the operator configured (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, listed in the client's "Authorized redirect URIs"), and that page posts the code to `finish`; the server takes no redirect URI from the client here either.

1. The page makes a PKCE pair as above, keeps the verifier in the tab (`sessionStorage`), and sends `POST /auth/sso/google/web/start` with the challenge.
2. It checks the `authUrl` as the game does, except that its `redirect_uri` must be a page of its own origin, then navigates to it. No Google script is loaded.
3. Google sends the browser to `GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI?code=...&state=...`. The page accepts only the `state` of the start answer and sends nothing after an `error=` redirect.
4. `finish`, `link` and `complete` follow as for the game. The attempt remembers that a website started it: the code is exchanged with the website's client and page, and the ID token must name that client (a code or ID token of the game's client fails with 502 `sso_failed`, and the reverse).

A Google account reaches the same Scacelith account from the game and from the website: the link holds Google's subject (`sub`), which identifies the Google account whatever the client. The website's origin must be in `CORS_ORIGINS` (`check-config` warns otherwise).

**Which account the Google sign-in reaches:** the account already linked to that Google account; otherwise an active account with the address that Google confirmed (with a password, `finish` answers `needsPassword` and the link is stored only once its password, then its second factor when it is on, pass; without a password, 409 `sso_account_exists`); otherwise a new account (`needsUsername`). A Google account is never linked to an existing account by its address alone. The account's address gets a mail when Google sign-in creates an account and when it is added to an existing one.
/tags/3/description.text:
Na voljo, kadar `GET /info` vrne `sso.google: true`; sicer vse spodnje končne točke odgovorijo 404 `sso_disabled`. Spletno mesto se prijavi na enak način s svojim odjemalcem, kadar je `sso.googleWeb` true (spodaj, **Na spletnem mestu**). Igra se prijavi prek sistemskega brskalnika s potekom za nameščene aplikacije po RFC 8252 (odjemalec vrste »Desktop app«): Google brskalnik preusmeri nazaj k poslušalcu igre na `127.0.0.1`, nikoli na ta strežnik, igra pa nikoli ne vidi nobene Googlove poverilnice.

1. Odjemalec posluša na `127.0.0.1:0` (vrata izbere sistem) in ustvari par PKCE: `codeVerifier` s 43 do 128 znaki `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` in `codeChallenge = BASE64URL(SHA-256(codeVerifier))`, ki ima 43 znakov in nima zapolnitve.
2. `POST /auth/sso/google/start` z izzivom in vrati vrne Googlov URL in `state` poskusa. Odjemalec URL preveri (spodaj) in ga odpre v brskalniku.
3. Google brskalnik preusmeri na `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth2/google/<tag>?code=...&state=...`. Odjemalec sprejme samo `state` iz odgovora na začetek in po preusmeritvi z `error=` ne pošlje ničesar.
4. `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` z ID-jem poskusa, `codeVerifier`, `state` in `code` (ter `iss`, če ga je Google poslal).
5. Odgovor je seja, korak dvofaktorskega preverjanja pristnosti (nadaljujte s `POST /auth/login/mfa`), `needsUsername` za novega igralca (nadaljujte s `POST /auth/sso/complete`) ali `needsPassword`, kadar naslov uporablja račun z geslom (nadaljujte s `POST /auth/sso/google/link`).

**Oznaka izvora.** URI za preusmeritev vsebuje oznako strežnika, ki ga je igralec dodal, tako da igra zavrne URL, ki ga je drug strežnik pridobil za svoje igralce. Izvor je gostitelj z malimi črkami (dobesedni naslov IPv6 v oglatih oklepajih), `:` in decimalna vrata API, vedno zapisana, tudi 443: strežnik vzame `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` in svoja javna vrata API, igra pa naslov, s katerim je povezana. Oznaka je prvih 22 znakov base64url (brez zapolnitve) vrednosti SHA-256(UTF-8 `"scacelith-sso-origin-v1\n"` + izvor). URI za preusmeritev je `"http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/oauth2/google/" + tag`: vedno dobesedni naslov IPv4 in vrata poslušalca igre (od 1024 do 65535). Strežnik od odjemalca nikoli ne vzame URI-ja, gostitelja ali poti.

| Izvor | Oznaka |
|---|---|
| `play.scacelith.example:443` | `IhcScoV7eDOzTEcSnqPUPt` |
| `localhost:8443` | `TFGx7zQ_8QlGZW5zpqznCr` |
| `[::1]:8443` | `XToJm0DG5PjciEVmZa9Cho` |
| `127.0.0.1:50443` | `3r653wM5ZjYsHcAJljmCwY` |

Prijava z Googlom torej deluje samo za igralce, ki so strežnik dodali natanko pod `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` in njegovimi javnimi vrati API.

**Kaj igra preveri, preden odpre brskalnik.** `authUrl` se začne natanko z `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?`, je v natisljivem ASCII in krajši od 4096 znakov, njegova poizvedba pa ima natanko en `response_type=code`, natanko en `redirect_uri`, enak URI-ju, ki ga igra izračuna iz svojih vrat in svoje oznake izvora, natanko en `state`, enak `state` iz odgovora, `code_challenge_method=S256` in 43-znakovni `code_challenge`. Sicer igra ustavi svojega poslušalca in ne odpre ničesar. `finish` in `link` pošlje samo strežniku, ki je odgovoril na `start`.

**Na spletnem mestu.** Spletno mesto (uradno: <https://scacelith.com/>) se prijavi z odjemalcem vrste »Web application« istega Googlovega projekta (`GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID`). Google brskalnik preusmeri nazaj na eno stran spletnega mesta, ki jo je nastavil upravljavec (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, navedena med »Authorized redirect URIs« odjemalca), ta stran pa kodo pošlje na `finish`; strežnik tudi tu od odjemalca ne vzame nobenega URI-ja za preusmeritev.

1. Stran ustvari par PKCE kot zgoraj, preverjevalnik hrani v zavihku (`sessionStorage`) in pošlje `POST /auth/sso/google/web/start` z izzivom.
2. `authUrl` preveri tako kot igra, le da mora biti njegov `redirect_uri` stran z njenega lastnega izvora, nato pa ga odpre. Noben Googlov skript se ne naloži.
3. Google brskalnik preusmeri na `GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI?code=...&state=...`. Stran sprejme samo `state` iz odgovora na začetek in po preusmeritvi z `error=` ne pošlje ničesar.
4. `finish`, `link` in `complete` sledijo kot pri igri. Poskus si zapomni, da ga je začelo spletno mesto: koda se zamenja z odjemalcem in stranjo spletnega mesta, žeton ID pa mora navajati ta odjemalec (koda ali žeton ID odjemalca igre ne uspe z 502 `sso_failed`, in obratno).

Googlov račun iz igre in s spletnega mesta doseže isti račun Scacelith: povezava hrani Googlov subjekt (`sub`), ki določa Googlov račun ne glede na odjemalca. Izvor spletnega mesta mora biti v `CORS_ORIGINS` (sicer `check-config` opozori).

**Kateri račun doseže prijava z Googlom:** račun, ki je s tem Googlovim računom že povezan; sicer aktiven račun z naslovom, ki ga je potrdil Google (z geslom: `finish` odgovori `needsPassword`, povezava pa se shrani šele, ko uspešno prestaneta preverjanje njegovo geslo in nato, če je vklopljen, njegov drugi faktor; brez gesla: 409 `sso_account_exists`); sicer nov račun (`needsUsername`). Googlov račun se z obstoječim računom nikoli ne poveže samo na podlagi naslova. Na naslov računa je poslano sporočilo, ko prijava z Googlom ustvari račun in ko je dodana obstoječemu računu.

/tags/11/description.en:
Game records with their moves and clocks, and their PGN files.

**Game codes.** `status`: 1 `WhiteWins`, 2 `BlackWins`, 3 `Draw`, 4 `Aborted` (only finished games are stored). `result`: `1-0`, `0-1`, `1/2-1/2`, or `*` (aborted). `reason`, with its name (`termination`) and the words that end the PGN file's move text; codes 7, 14 and 21 are draws (the player who ran out of time, resigned or abandoned faced an opponent who could not checkmate: FIDE 6.9 and 5.1.2; `DESIGN.md` 6.3 gives the rule), and the server never ends a game with codes 4 and 13 (they belong to the shared list of reasons):

| Code | `termination` | Words in the PGN |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Checkmate` | Checkmate |
| 2 | `Resignation` | Resignation |
| 3 | `Timeout` | Loss on time |
| 4 | `IllegalMoves` | Second illegal move (forfeit) |
| 5 | `Stalemate` | Stalemate |
| 6 | `InsufficientMaterial` | Dead position (insufficient material) |
| 7 | `TimeoutVsInsufficient` | Flag fall, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 8 | `FivefoldRepetition` | Fivefold repetition |
| 9 | `SeventyFiveMoves` | 75-move rule |
| 10 | `ThreefoldClaim` | Threefold repetition (claimed) |
| 11 | `FiftyMoveClaim` | 50-move rule (claimed) |
| 12 | `Agreement` | Draw by agreement |
| 13 | `IllegalMovesVsInsufficient` | Second illegal move, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 14 | `ResignationVsInsufficient` | Resignation, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 20 | `Abandonment` | Abandoned (disconnected for too long) |
| 21 | `AbandonmentVsInsufficient` | Abandoned, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 22 | `Aborted` | Game aborted |
| 23 | `NoShow` | Aborted: first move not played in time |
| 24 | `Forfeit` | Forfeit (fair play violation) |
| 25 | `ServerAborted` | Aborted by the server |
| 26 | `BothDisconnected` | Aborted: both players disconnected |

Code 14 is new in protocol minor 1: a client written before it should show an unknown code as a plain end of game with its `result`.
/tags/11/description.text:
Zapisi partij s potezami in urami ter njihove datoteke PGN.

**Kode partij.** `status`: 1 `WhiteWins`, 2 `BlackWins`, 3 `Draw`, 4 `Aborted` (shranjene so samo končane partije). `result`: `1-0`, `0-1`, `1/2-1/2` ali `*` (preklicana). `reason` z imenom (`termination`) in besedami, s katerimi se konča zapis potez v datoteki PGN (v datoteki v angleščini, spodaj s prevodom); kode 7, 14 in 21 so remiji (igralec, ki mu je zmanjkalo časa, ki je predal ali ki je zapustil partijo, je imel nasprotnika, ki ni mogel dati mata: FIDE 6.9 in 5.1.2; pravilo navaja `DESIGN.md` 6.3), s kodama 4 in 13 pa strežnik nikoli ne konča partije (spadata na skupni seznam razlogov):

| Koda | `termination` | Besede v PGN |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Checkmate` | Checkmate (mat) |
| 2 | `Resignation` | Resignation (predaja) |
| 3 | `Timeout` | Loss on time (poraz na čas) |
| 4 | `IllegalMoves` | Second illegal move (forfeit) (druga nepravilna poteza, izguba partije) |
| 5 | `Stalemate` | Stalemate (pat) |
| 6 | `InsufficientMaterial` | Dead position (insufficient material) (mrtva pozicija, nezadosten material) |
| 7 | `TimeoutVsInsufficient` | Flag fall, but the opponent cannot checkmate (padec zastavice, a nasprotnik ne more dati mata) |
| 8 | `FivefoldRepetition` | Fivefold repetition (petkratna ponovitev pozicije) |
| 9 | `SeventyFiveMoves` | 75-move rule (pravilo 75 potez) |
| 10 | `ThreefoldClaim` | Threefold repetition (claimed) (trikratna ponovitev pozicije, na zahtevo) |
| 11 | `FiftyMoveClaim` | 50-move rule (claimed) (pravilo 50 potez, na zahtevo) |
| 12 | `Agreement` | Draw by agreement (remi po dogovoru) |
| 13 | `IllegalMovesVsInsufficient` | Second illegal move, but the opponent cannot checkmate (druga nepravilna poteza, a nasprotnik ne more dati mata) |
| 14 | `ResignationVsInsufficient` | Resignation, but the opponent cannot checkmate (predaja, a nasprotnik ne more dati mata) |
| 20 | `Abandonment` | Abandoned (disconnected for too long) (zapuščena partija, predolgo brez povezave) |
| 21 | `AbandonmentVsInsufficient` | Abandoned, but the opponent cannot checkmate (zapuščena partija, a nasprotnik ne more dati mata) |
| 22 | `Aborted` | Game aborted (partija je preklicana) |
| 23 | `NoShow` | Aborted: first move not played in time (preklicano: prva poteza ni bila pravočasno odigrana) |
| 24 | `Forfeit` | Forfeit (fair play violation) (poraz zaradi kršitve pravil poštene igre) |

/tags/12/description.en:
A game as an animated GIF, to keep or to share: the board seen from above, one frame per position from the start to the final position, the players' names and ratings above the board, the last move below it, and on the last frame the result and how the game ended.

**Cost, cache and quotas.** A GIF is made on a rendering thread of its own, never on the threads that run the games, and at the lowest CPU priority: `GIF_THREADS` threads (`WORKERS` by default), started with the first GIF and stopped after a minute without one. Up to `GIF_QUEUE_MAX` (4 x `WORKERS`) GIFs wait for a thread, at most `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 s) each; a render may last `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` (30 s). The server keeps the GIFs it made in a cache of `GIF_CACHE_MB` MB (32 x `WORKERS`), the least recently used going first; a GIF from the cache, or one being made for another request, costs no render. The cache keys on everything that changes the picture, names included.

Every request counts in `gif` (30 per minute per player for both endpoints). A GIF that has to be made also counts in the render limits: per player `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (4) per minute and `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (30) per hour; per client, all its accounts together, `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (12) per minute and `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (120) per hour, and 3 times that per IPv6 /48. A client should keep the file it downloaded rather than ask for it again, and wait `retryAfter` after a 429 or a 503.

Sizes: `small` (32 px squares: 284 x 350 pixels), `medium` (48 px: 424 x 515), `large` (72 px: 628 x 762); without coordinates 268 x 342, 400 x 503 and 600 x 748. The start position stays at least 1 s (the delay when it is longer), the final position 3 s, and the GIF loops; after the first frame, only the part of the picture that changes is stored. A 40-move game takes about 135, 205 and 325 KiB (small, medium, large), a 150-move game 0.5, 0.8 and 1.2 MiB.
/tags/12/description.text:
Partija kot animirani GIF, za shranjevanje ali deljenje: šahovnica, gledana od zgoraj, ena sličica na pozicijo od začetne do končne pozicije, imena in ratingi igralcev nad šahovnico, zadnja poteza pod njo, na zadnji sličici pa rezultat in način, kako se je partija končala.

**Strošek, predpomnilnik in kvote.** GIF se izdela v lastni niti za upodabljanje, nikoli v nitih, ki izvajajo partije, in z najnižjo prioriteto CPE: `GIF_THREADS` niti (privzeto `WORKERS`), ki se zaženejo s prvim GIF-om in ustavijo po minuti brez njega. Do `GIF_QUEUE_MAX` (4 x `WORKERS`) GIF-ov čaka na nit, vsak največ `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 s); upodabljanje lahko traja `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` (30 s). Strežnik izdelane GIF-e hrani v predpomnilniku velikosti `GIF_CACHE_MB` MB (32 x `WORKERS`), pri čemer se najprej odstranijo najdlje neuporabljeni; GIF iz predpomnilnika ali GIF, ki se že izdeluje za drugo zahtevo, ne porabi upodabljanja. Ključ predpomnilnika zajema vse, kar spremeni sliko, vključno z imeni.

Vsaka zahteva se šteje v `gif` (30 na minuto na igralca za obe končni točki). GIF, ki ga je treba izdelati, se šteje tudi v omejitve upodabljanja: na igralca `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (4) na minuto in `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (30) na uro; na odjemalca, za vse njegove račune skupaj, `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (12) na minuto in `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (120) na uro ter trikrat toliko na IPv6 /48. Odjemalec naj preneseno datoteko raje obdrži, kot da jo znova zahteva, po 429 ali 503 pa naj počaka `retryAfter`.

Velikosti: `small` (polja po 32 px: 284 x 350 slikovnih pik), `medium` (48 px: 424 x 515), `large` (72 px: 628 x 762); brez koordinat 268 x 342, 400 x 503 in 600 x 748. Začetna pozicija je prikazana vsaj 1 s (oziroma toliko, kolikor znaša zamik, če je daljši), končna pozicija 3 s, GIF pa se ponavlja; po prvi sličici se shrani samo del slike, ki se spremeni. Partija s 40 potezami zavzame približno 135, 205 in 325 KiB (small, medium, large), partija s 150 potezami pa 0,5 MiB, 0,8 MiB in 1,2 MiB.

/tags/16/description.en:
Pages for a browser, opened from the links of e-mails. Their links point to `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>` (with `:<PUBLIC_API_PORT>` when it is not 443), outside `/api/v1`.

- The pages run no JavaScript and load no external resource. They are served with `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`.
- A `GET` only shows a button or a form, so that a mail scanner opening the link does not use it up. The change happens on `POST`: a form sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (a JSON body is accepted too), with the link's token in a hidden field. A field given twice is refused.
- Errors (rate limits, invalid fields) are HTML pages too, titled "Request refused" or, from 500 on, "Server error". Only the failures found before the page is matched (a request target that is too long or malformed, the per-address layer) answer in JSON.
/tags/16/description.text:
Strani za brskalnik, ki se odprejo s povezavami v e-poštnih sporočilih. Njihove povezave kažejo na `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>` (z `:<PUBLIC_API_PORT>`, če ta ni 443), zunaj `/api/v1`.

- Strani ne izvajajo JavaScripta in ne nalagajo zunanjih virov. Strežejo se z `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`.
- `GET` samo prikaže gumb ali obrazec, tako da pregledovalnik e-pošte, ki odpre povezavo, te ne porabi. Sprememba se zgodi ob `POST`: obrazec, poslan kot `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (sprejeto je tudi telo JSON), z žetonom povezave v skritem polju. Polje, podano dvakrat, je zavrnjeno.
- Tudi napake (omejitve števila zahtev, neveljavna polja) so strani HTML, z naslovom »Request refused« (zahteva zavrnjena) ali, od 500 naprej, »Server error« (napaka strežnika). V JSON odgovorijo samo napake, odkrite, preden je stran prepoznana (predolg ali napačno oblikovan cilj zahteve, sloj po naslovu).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/description.en:
Creates an account: once its e-mail address is confirmed with the link sent to it, or at once without e-mail confirmation.

**With e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, the default): 202 `verification_sent`. No account exists yet: the signup waits for 24 hours and holds its username meanwhile. A link valid for those 24 hours goes to the address, at most one per address every 5 minutes (`POST /auth/verify-email/resend` sends a new one); the account is created, its address confirmed, when the link is used (the button of the `/verify-email` page), and the player can then sign in. Until then a sign-in with that username answers `invalid_credentials`, as for an unknown account, and the public profile does not exist. A new signup with the same address replaces the waiting one. The answer is the same when another account already uses the address: no link is sent then, its owner gets a notice instead (at most one per hour), and the username is held in the same way, so that nothing tells whether the address has an account. A signup whose link was not used is dropped after 24 hours, and its username is free again.

**Without e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): 201 `ready`, the account is created at once and can sign in.

**Rules.** `username`: `USERNAME_MIN` to `USERNAME_MAX` characters (3 to 20), letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit (`GET /info` gives them as `limits`); reserved names (`admin`, `moderator`, `deleted`...) and some prefixes are refused; unique without regard to case. `email`: trimmed and stored in lower case, plain ASCII with a dotted domain. `password`: at least `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` (10) characters and at most 256 bytes of UTF-8; it must not contain the user name or the e-mail's local part, and must not be a common password.

**Errors**, checked in this order: 403 `registration_closed`; 400 `invalid_username`; 400 `invalid_email`; 400 `weak_password`; 409 `username_taken`; 428 `pow_required`; the password hash queue errors; 409 `email_taken` (only without e-mail confirmation).

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_register` (10 registrations per hour per client). **Proof of work:** always, when `POW_REGISTER_BITS` is above 0.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/description.text:
Ustvari račun: ko je njegov e-poštni naslov potrjen s povezavo, poslano nanj, ali takoj, če potrditev e-pošte ni vklopljena.

**S potrditvijo e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, privzeto): 202 `verification_sent`. Račun še ne obstaja: registracija čaka 24 ur in medtem zadrži svoje uporabniško ime. Na naslov se pošlje povezava, veljavna teh 24 ur, največ ena na naslov vsakih 5 minut (`POST /auth/verify-email/resend` pošlje novo); račun se ustvari, z že potrjenim naslovom, ko je povezava uporabljena (gumb na strani `/verify-email`), nato se igralec lahko prijavi. Do takrat je odgovor na prijavo s tem uporabniškim imenom `invalid_credentials`, tako kot za neznan račun, javni profil pa ne obstaja. Nova registracija z istim naslovom nadomesti čakajočo. Odgovor je enak, kadar naslov že uporablja drug račun: povezava se takrat ne pošlje, temveč lastnik tega računa dobi obvestilo (največ eno na uro), uporabniško ime pa je zadržano na enak način, tako da nič ne razkrije, ali ima naslov račun. Registracija, katere povezava ni bila uporabljena, se po 24 urah zavrže, njeno uporabniško ime pa je spet prosto.

**Brez potrditve e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): 201 `ready`, račun je ustvarjen takoj in z njim se je mogoče prijaviti.

**Pravila.** `username`: od `USERNAME_MIN` do `USERNAME_MAX` znakov (od 3 do 20), črke, števke, `_` in `-`, na začetku črka ali števka (`GET /info` jih vrne kot `limits`); rezervirana imena (`admin`, `moderator`, `deleted` ...) in nekatere predpone so zavrnjeni; enolično ne glede na velike in male črke. `email`: brez začetnih in končnih presledkov in shranjen z malimi črkami, navaden ASCII z domeno, ki vsebuje piko. `password`: najmanj `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` (10) znakov in največ 256 bajtov UTF-8; ne sme vsebovati uporabniškega imena ali lokalnega dela e-poštnega naslova in ne sme biti pogosto geslo.

**Napake**, preverjene v tem vrstnem redu: 403 `registration_closed`; 400 `invalid_username`; 400 `invalid_email`; 400 `weak_password`; 409 `username_taken`; 428 `pow_required`; napake čakalne vrste za zgoščevanje gesel; 409 `email_taken` (samo brez potrditve e-pošte).

**Omejitve:** `auth`, nato `auth_register` (10 registracij na uro na odjemalca). **Dokaz o delu:** vedno, kadar je `POW_REGISTER_BITS` večji od 0.

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/requestBody.en: First attempt, without a proof of work
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/requestBody.text: Prvi poskus, brez dokaza o delu
