/paths/~1auth~1register/post/requestBody.text: Ponovno poslano z dokazom o delu

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.en: The account is created and can sign in (no e-mail confirmation on this server).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.text: Račun je ustvarjen in z njim se je mogoče prijaviti (na tem strežniku ni potrditve e-pošte).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.en: The signup waits for its confirmation link (or the address already has an account; the answer does not tell).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.text: Registracija čaka na svojo potrditveno povezavo (ali pa ima naslov že račun; odgovor tega ne razkrije).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `registration_closed`: registration is closed on this server (`GET /info` says `registration: closed`).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `registration_closed`: registracija je na tem strežniku zaprta (`GET /info` vrne `registration: closed`).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `username_taken`: an account has the username, or a waiting signup of another address holds it. `email_taken`: another account uses the address (only without e-mail confirmation).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `username_taken`: uporabniško ime že ima neki račun ali pa ga zadržuje čakajoča registracija z drugim naslovom. `email_taken`: naslov uporablja drug račun (samo brez potrditve e-pošte).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `rate_limited`: the `auth` or `auth_register` limit, or the password hash queue.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `rate_limited`: omejitev `auth` ali `auth_register` ali čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel.

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/5.en: `server_busy` (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/5.text: `server_busy` (čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel ali pa je zbirka podatkov ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/description.en:
Signs in with a user name or e-mail address and a password. There are two possible answers, both with status 200: a session, or, when two-step verification is on, a second step to complete within 5 minutes with `POST /auth/login/mfa`.

Unknown account, wrong password and account without a password get the same answer, after the same time: 401 `invalid_credentials`. The account checks (`banned`, `email_unverified`) come only after a correct password. From `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) failures on one login name, each attempt must wait (429 `too_many_attempts`).

**Limit:** `auth`. **Proof of work:** only during a wave of failed sign-ins (428 `pow_required`).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/description.text:
Prijava z uporabniškim imenom ali e-poštnim naslovom in geslom. Možna sta dva odgovora, oba s statusom 200: seja ali, kadar je dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti vklopljeno, drugi korak, ki ga je treba v 5 minutah dokončati s `POST /auth/login/mfa`.

Neznan račun, napačno geslo in račun brez gesla dobijo enak odgovor po enakem času: 401 `invalid_credentials`. Preverjanja računa (`banned`, `email_unverified`) sledijo šele po pravilnem geslu. Od `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) neuspehov z istim prijavnim imenom naprej mora vsak poskus počakati (429 `too_many_attempts`).

**Omejitev:** `auth`. **Dokaz o delu:** samo med valom neuspelih prijav (428 `pow_required`).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/200/.en: A session, or the second step of a sign-in with two-step verification.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/200/.text: Seja ali drugi korak prijave z dvofaktorskim preverjanjem pristnosti.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/401/.en: `invalid_credentials`: unknown account, wrong password, or an account without a password.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/401/.text: `invalid_credentials`: neznan račun, napačno geslo ali račun brez gesla.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/403/.en: After a correct password only: `banned`, with `until` (epoch ms, `null` for a permanent ban), or `email_unverified` (an older account whose address is not confirmed yet).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/403/.text: Samo po pravilnem geslu: `banned` z `until` (ms od epohe Unix, `null` za trajno blokado) ali `email_unverified` (starejši račun, katerega naslov še ni potrjen).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/429/.en: `too_many_attempts` (the failure delay of this login name), or `rate_limited` (the `auth` limit, the password hash queue).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/429/.text: `too_many_attempts` (zamik po neuspelih poskusih za to prijavno ime) ali `rate_limited` (omejitev `auth`, čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/503/.en: `server_busy` (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/503/.text: `server_busy` (čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel ali pa je zbirka podatkov ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/summary.en: Complete a sign-in with a second factor

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/descripti.en:
The second step of a sign-in with two-step verification, after `POST /auth/login` or a Google sign-in (`POST /auth/sso/google/finish` or `POST /auth/sso/google/link`) answered `mfaRequired`. Send `code` (a 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code) or `recoveryCode`. A recovery code used here is gone.

One step accepts at most 5 wrong codes; the step also ends when the password is reset or changed. After the password step of a Google link, the link is stored only when the code passes here.

**Limits:** `auth`, and at most `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) codes per 15 minutes for the account, from any address; beyond it the code is not checked, so a recovery code is not spent.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/descripti.text:
Drugi korak prijave z dvofaktorskim preverjanjem pristnosti, potem ko je bil odgovor na `POST /auth/login` ali na prijavo z Googlom (`POST /auth/sso/google/finish` ali `POST /auth/sso/google/link`) `mfaRequired`. Pošljite `code` (6-mestno kodo iz aplikacije ali obnovitveno kodo) ali `recoveryCode`. Obnovitvena koda, uporabljena tukaj, je porabljena.

En korak sprejme največ 5 napačnih kod; korak se konča tudi, ko je geslo ponastavljeno ali spremenjeno. Po koraku z geslom pri povezovanju z Googlom se povezava shrani šele, ko koda tukaj uspešno prestane preverjanje.

**Omejitve:** `auth` in največ `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) kod na 15 minut za račun, s katerega koli naslova; nad tem se koda ne preveri, zato se obnovitvena koda ne porabi.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `invalid_request`: neither `code` nor `recoveryCode` was sent, or the body breaks the schema; `invalid_json`.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `invalid_request`: poslana ni bila niti `code` niti `recoveryCode` ali pa telo krši shemo; `invalid_json`.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `invalid_mfa_token`: the step expired, was used, or ended after 5 wrong codes, or the password was reset or changed since the first step (sign in again). `invalid_code`: a wrong or already used code.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `invalid_mfa_token`: korak je potekel, je bil uporabljen ali se je končal po 5 napačnih kodah ali pa je bilo geslo po prvem koraku ponastavljeno ali spremenjeno (znova se prijavite). `invalid_code`: napačna ali že uporabljena koda.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `sso_already_linked`: after the password step of a Google link only, the Google account was linked to another account meanwhile.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `sso_already_linked`: samo po koraku z geslom pri povezovanju z Googlom, kadar je bil Googlov račun medtem povezan z drugim računom.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `sso_expired`: after the password step of a Google link only, the account changed meanwhile; start the sign-in again.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `sso_expired`: samo po koraku z geslom pri povezovanju z Googlom, kadar se je račun medtem spremenil; prijavo začnite znova.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `too_many_attempts`: the account's failure delay, or its `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` codes of the last 15 minutes are used up. `rate_limited`: the `auth` limit.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `too_many_attempts`: zamik po neuspelih poskusih računa ali pa je njegovih `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` kod v zadnjih 15 minutah porabljenih. `rate_limited`: omejitev `auth`.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked (after a Google link step, nothing was linked: start the sign-in again). `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `server_busy` z `retryAfter: 1`: zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena (po koraku povezovanja z Googlom ni bilo nič povezano: prijavo začnite znova). `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1logout/post/description.en:
Revokes the session of the token used. The WebSocket opened with it is closed. No body (or `{}`).

**Limit:** `sessions`.
/paths/~1auth~1logout/post/description.text:
Prekliče sejo uporabljenega žetona. WebSocket, odprt z njim, se zapre. Brez telesa (ali `{}`).

**Omejitev:** `sessions`.

/paths/~1auth~1logout/post/responses/429.en: `rate_limited`: the `sessions` limit or the account budget.

/paths/~1auth~1logout/post/responses/503.en: `server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1logout/post/responses/503.text: `server_busy` (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1logout-all/post/descripti.en:
Revokes every session of the account, this one included. The WebSockets opened with them are closed. No body (or `{}`).

**Limit:** `sessions`.
/paths/~1auth~1logout-all/post/descripti.text:
Prekliče vse seje računa, vključno s to. WebSocketi, odprti z njimi, se zaprejo. Brez telesa (ali `{}`).

**Omejitev:** `sessions`.

/paths/~1auth~1logout-all/post/responses.en: `rate_limited`: the `sessions` limit or the account budget.
`server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1logout-all/post/responses.text: `server_busy` (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en:
Sends the e-mail confirmation link again. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address, so that it never tells whether an account or a signup uses it.

A request acts at most once every 5 minutes per address. A signup waiting with that address gets its 24 hours again, whether or not another account uses the address, so that its username stays held as long in both cases. A link is sent only for that signup when the address has no account (a new link, valid 24 hours, replaces the previous one), or for an active, unconfirmed account with that address.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_mail` (10 per hour per client).
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text:
Znova pošlje povezavo za potrditev e-poštnega naslova. Odgovor je 202 `accepted` ne glede na naslov, tako da nikoli ne razkrije, ali ga uporablja račun ali registracija.

Zahteva učinkuje največ enkrat vsakih 5 minut na naslov. Registracija, ki čaka s tem naslovom, znova dobi svojih 24 ur, ne glede na to, ali naslov uporablja drug račun, tako da njeno uporabniško ime v obeh primerih ostane zadržano enako dolgo. Povezava se pošlje samo za to registracijo, kadar naslov nima računa (nova povezava, veljavna 24 ur, nadomesti prejšnjo), ali za aktiven, nepotrjen račun s tem naslovom.

**Omejitve:** `auth`, nato `auth_mail` (10 na uro na odjemalca).

/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link of an unconfirmed account was stored (the renewal of a waiting signup is best effort and never fails the request); the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them does nothing. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text: `server_busy` z `retryAfter: 1`: zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena med iskanjem računa ali shranjevanjem povezave nepotrjenega računa (podaljšanje čakajoče registracije se izvede po najboljših močeh in zaradi njega zahteva nikoli ne spodleti); 5 minut za naslov se kljub temu začne šteti, zato nova zahteva v tem času ne naredi ničesar. `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.en:
Sends a password reset link, valid for one hour, which opens the page `/reset-password`. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address. A link goes only to an active account, at most once every 5 minutes per address. A Google-only account sets its first password this way.

Password recovery has the strictest limits of the API, all counted for the whole server: 3 requests per hour (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) and 10 per 24 hours (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) per client (an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /64), 3 times those numbers per IPv6 /48, on top of the `auth` limit (20 per 10 minutes) and of the one mail per address every 5 minutes. Neither the 202 nor the 429 tells whether an account uses the address. Setting the new password has its own limit (`auth_reset`).

**Limits:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, then `auth_forgot_day`.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.text:
Pošlje povezavo za ponastavitev gesla, veljavno eno uro, ki odpre stran `/reset-password`. Odgovor je 202 `accepted` ne glede na naslov. Povezava se pošlje samo aktivnemu računu, največ enkrat vsakih 5 minut na naslov. Račun samo s prijavo z Googlom na ta način nastavi svoje prvo geslo.

Obnovitev gesla ima najstrožje omejitve v API-ju, vse štete za celoten strežnik: 3 zahteve na uro (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) in 10 na 24 ur (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) na odjemalca (naslov IPv4 ali IPv6 /64), trikrat toliko na IPv6 /48, poleg omejitve `auth` (20 na 10 minut) in enega sporočila na naslov vsakih 5 minut. Niti 202 niti 429 ne razkrije, ali naslov uporablja kateri koli račun. Nastavitev novega gesla ima lastno omejitev (`auth_reset`).

**Omejitve:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, nato `auth_forgot_day`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link was stored; the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them sends no link. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.text: `server_busy` z `retryAfter: 1`: zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena med iskanjem računa ali shranjevanjem povezave; 5 minut za naslov se kljub temu začne šteti, zato nova zahteva v tem času ne pošlje povezave. `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/summ.en: Set a new password with a reset link's token
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/summ.text: Nastavitev novega gesla z žetonom povezave za ponastavitev

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.en:
Sets a new password with the token of a reset link (the page `/reset-password` does the same). The new password follows the rules of registration.

The reset has these effects, in one transaction (all of them, or none): it revokes every session and cancels a pending e-mail change; the other reset links of the account stop working; the address counts as confirmed (the link proved it); the owner gets a mail. Two-step verification is not touched. After a password hash queue error, a 503 or a 500, nothing changed: the old password and the sessions stay, and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (10 per hour per client, 30 per IPv6 /48, shared with the page: each attempt hashes a password).
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.text:
Nastavi novo geslo z žetonom povezave za ponastavitev gesla (stran `/reset-password` naredi enako). Za novo geslo veljajo pravila registracije.

Ponastavitev ima te učinke, v eni transakciji (vse ali nobenega): prekliče vse seje in razveljavi čakajočo spremembo e-poštnega naslova; druge povezave za ponastavitev gesla tega računa prenehajo delovati; naslov šteje kot potrjen (povezava je to dokazala); lastnik dobi e-poštno sporočilo. Dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti ostane nespremenjeno. Po napaki čakalne vrste za zgoščevanje gesel, 503 ali 500 ni bilo nič spremenjeno: staro geslo in seje ostanejo, povezava pa ostane veljavna.

**Omejitve:** `auth`, nato `auth_reset` (10 na uro na odjemalca, 30 na IPv6 /48, deljena s stranjo: vsak poskus zgosti geslo).

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: The password is changed and every session is signed out.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: Geslo je spremenjeno in vse seje so odjavljene.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `invalid_token`: the link is invalid, used or expired, or was mailed to an address the account no longer has. `weak_password` (with `reason`). `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `invalid_token`: povezava je neveljavna, uporabljena ali potekla ali pa je bila poslana na naslov, ki ga račun nima več. `weak_password` (z `reason`). `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `rate_limited`: the `auth` or `auth_reset` limit, or the password hash queue.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `rate_limited`: omejitev `auth` ali `auth_reset` ali čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `server_busy`: the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked (`retryAfter: 1`, nothing changed). `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `server_busy`: čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel ali pa je zbirka podatkov ostala zaklenjena (`retryAfter: 1`, nič ni bilo spremenjeno). `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.en:
Starts a Google sign-in attempt for the PKCE challenge and the port of the game's listener on `127.0.0.1`. The answer gives the Google URL to open in the system browser and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes.

`authUrl` holds `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (built from `redirectPort` and the server's origin tag), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (S256 of the server's own verifier for Google) with `code_challenge_method=S256`, and `prompt=select_account`. The game checks it before it opens it (see the tag description).

**Limit:** `sso_start`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.text:
Začne poskus prijave z Googlom za izziv PKCE in vrata poslušalca igre na `127.0.0.1`. Odgovor vrne Googlov URL, ki ga je treba odpreti v sistemskem brskalniku, in `state` poskusa; poskus velja 10 minut.

`authUrl` vsebuje `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (sestavljen iz `redirectPort` in oznake izvora strežnika), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (S256 strežnikovega lastnega preverjevalnika za Google) s `code_challenge_method=S256` in `prompt=select_account`. Igra ga preveri, preden ga odpre (glejte opis razdelka).

**Omejitev:** `sso_start`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/r.en: `sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/r.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava z Googlom na tem strežniku ni na voljo.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/r.en: `server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/r.text: `server_busy` (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: Start a Google sign-in on a website
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: Začetek prijave z Googlom na spletnem mestu

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en:
Starts a Google sign-in attempt of a website for the PKCE challenge of its page. The answer is the same as for the game: the Google URL to navigate to, and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes. Offered when `GET /info` says `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` holds the website's `client_id` and `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, with the same other parameters as for the game. The page checks it before it navigates to it (see **On a website** in the tag description).

**Limit:** `sso_start`, shared with the game's start.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text:
Začne poskus prijave z Googlom za spletno mesto, za izziv PKCE njegove strani. Odgovor je enak kot za igro: Googlov URL, ki ga je treba odpreti, in `state` poskusa; poskus velja 10 minut. Na voljo, kadar `GET /info` vrne `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` vsebuje `client_id` spletnega mesta in `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, z enakimi drugimi parametri kot za igro. Stran ga preveri, preden ga odpre (glejte **Na spletnem mestu** v opisu razdelka).

**Omejitev:** `sso_start`, deljena z začetkom prijave v igri.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: `invalid_request`: a missing or malformed `codeChallenge`, or any other field (`redirectPort` included).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: `invalid_request`: manjkajoč ali napačno oblikovan `codeChallenge` ali katero koli drugo polje (vključno z `redirectPort`).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: `sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server, or not to websites.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava z Googlom na tem strežniku ni na voljo ali pa ni na voljo spletnim mestom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: `rate_limited`: the `sso_start` limit (shared with the game's start).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: `rate_limited`: omejitev `sso_start` (deljena z začetkom prijave v igri).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: `server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: `server_busy` (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: Hand Google's answer to the server
A session, a second step, or the next step of a first Google sign-in.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: Seja, drugi korak ali naslednji korak prve prijave z Googlom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: Signed in to the linked account
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: Prijava v povezani račun je uspela

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: An account with a password uses the address

`invalid_verifier`: the verifier does not match the attempt's challenge (the attempt stays usable). `sso_email_unverified`: Google has not confirmed the address. `registration_closed`. `account_disabled`. For a linked account only: `banned` (with `until`), `email_unverified`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `invalid_verifier`: preverjevalnik se ne ujema z izzivom poskusa (poskus ostane uporaben). `sso_email_unverified`: Google ni potrdil naslova. `registration_closed`. `account_disabled`. Samo za povezan račun: `banned` (z `until`), `email_unverified`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: `sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava z Googlom na tem strežniku ni na voljo.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: `sso_account_exists`: an active account without a password uses the address (it is not named).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `sso_account_exists`: naslov uporablja aktiven račun brez gesla (ta ni imenovan).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: `sso_expired`: an unknown, used or expired attempt.
`server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `server_busy` (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena), `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.en: Link Google to an existing account with its password
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.text: Povezovanje Googla z obstoječim računom z geslom tega računa

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.en:
After `finish` answered `needsPassword`: links Google to the existing account with that account's password, typed in the game. The answer (200) is a session (the link is stored and the player signed in), or, when two-step verification is on, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`, and the link is stored only when a code passes there.

A wrong password leaves the ticket usable, for 5 tries in all. A try is taken just before the password is checked: a 429 `too_many_attempts` or a 428 `pow_required` takes none, while a refusal of the password hash queue (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) has taken one and counts as a failure of the account. The failure delay is the same counter as `POST /auth/login`.

**Limit:** `auth` (with its IPv6 /48 count). **Proof of work:** as for `POST /auth/login`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.text:
Potem ko je `finish` odgovoril z `needsPassword`: poveže Google z obstoječim računom z geslom tega računa, vnesenim v igri. Odgovor (200) je seja (povezava je shranjena in igralec prijavljen) ali, kadar je dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti vklopljeno, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: nadaljujte s `POST /auth/login/mfa`, povezava pa se shrani šele, ko tam koda uspešno prestane preverjanje.

Napačno geslo pusti vstopnico uporabno, skupno za 5 poskusov. Poskus se porabi tik pred preverjanjem gesla: 429 `too_many_attempts` ali 428 `pow_required` ne porabi nobenega, zavrnitev čakalne vrste za zgoščevanje gesel (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) pa je enega že porabila in šteje kot neuspeh računa. Zamik po neuspelih poskusih uporablja isti števec kot `POST /auth/login`.

**Omejitev:** `auth` (s štetjem po IPv6 /48). **Dokaz o delu:** kot pri `POST /auth/login`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: A session, or the second step of the sign-in.
`invalid_credentials`: a wrong password; the ticket stays, for 5 tries in all.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `invalid_credentials`: napačno geslo; vstopnica ostane veljavna za skupno 5 poskusov.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_disabled`: ta strežnik ne ponuja prijave z Googlom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_already_linked`: the Google account was linked to another account meanwhile.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_already_linked`: Googlov račun je bil medtem povezan z drugim računom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_expired`: an unknown, used or expired ticket, the 5th wrong password, an account whose status or address changed since `finish`, or one whose status, address, password or two-step verification changed while the link was being stored. Start the sign-in again.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_expired`: neznana, že uporabljena ali potekla vstopnica, peto napačno geslo, račun, katerega stanje ali naslov se je spremenil po `finish`, ali račun, katerega stanje, naslov, geslo ali dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti se je spremenilo med shranjevanjem povezave. Znova začnite prijavo.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `too_many_attempts` (the account's failure delay), or `rate_limited` (the `auth` limit, the password hash queue).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `too_many_attempts` (zamik po neuspelih poskusih računa) ali `rate_limited` (omejitev `auth`, čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `server_busy`: the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked (`retryAfter: 1`, nothing was linked). `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `server_busy`: čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel ali pa je zbirka podatkov ostala zaklenjena (`retryAfter: 1`, nič ni bilo povezano). `timeout`. Tudi `server_busy` z `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kadar strežnik močno zaostaja (glejte uvod): zahteva ni bila izvedena.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/summar.en: Create the account of a first Google sign-in
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/summar.text: Ustvarjanje računa ob prvi prijavi z Googlom

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/descri.en:
After `finish` answered `needsUsername`: creates the account with the chosen username (the rules of registration apply) and signs it in. The account has no password: `hasPassword` is `false`, and "Forgot password" (`POST /auth/password/forgot`) gives it one.

**Limit:** `auth` (with its IPv6 /48 count).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/descri.text:
Ko `finish` odgovori z `needsUsername`: ustvari račun z izbranim uporabniškim imenom (veljajo pravila registracije) in ga prijavi. Račun nima gesla: `hasPassword` je `false`, geslo pa mu nastavi »Pozabljeno geslo?« (`POST /auth/password/forgot`).

**Omejitev:** `auth` (s štetjem po IPv6 /48).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/respon.en: The account is created and signed in.
`sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/respon.text: `sso_disabled`: ta strežnik ne ponuja prijave z Googlom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1complete/post/respon.en: `username_taken` (an account has the username, or a waiting signup of another address holds it), `sso_already_linked`, `email_taken`.

/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.en:
Changes the account's e-mail address. `newEmail` is trimmed and lower-cased, then checked like a registration address.

**With e-mail confirmation** (the default): 202 `verification_sent`. A link valid for 24 hours goes to the new address; it opens `/confirm-email-change`, and the address changes only when the player presses that page's button. Until then, `GET /account/me` shows the new address as `pendingEmail`. A new request replaces the pending one; a password change or reset cancels it. At most one link goes to a given new address every 5 minutes, whoever asks (a request for the change already pending keeps the link sent earlier, which stays valid); the answer is the same. The current address gets a notice that a change to a masked address (`a***@example.org`) was requested. The answer and `pendingEmail` are the same when another account already uses the new address: no link is sent then, so that change never completes, and the owner of that address gets a notice (at most one per hour) instead.

When the link is confirmed, the address changes and counts as confirmed, the devices stay signed in, the links sent earlier (confirmation, password reset, other changes) stop working, and the former address is told, with the new one masked.

**Without e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): the address changes at once (200 `email_changed`), and the former address is told. If another account uses the address, the answer is 409 `email_taken`, and the owner of that address gets the notice.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. `invalid_email` and `same_email` are checked before the password, so they count no failure. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.text:
Spremeni e-poštni naslov računa. Iz `newEmail` se odstranijo presledki na začetku in koncu, pretvori se v male črke, nato pa se preveri kot naslov pri registraciji.

**S potrditvijo e-pošte** (privzeto): 202 `verification_sent`. Na novi naslov se pošlje povezava, veljavna 24 ur; odpre `/confirm-email-change`, naslov pa se spremeni šele, ko igralec pritisne gumb na tej strani. Do takrat `GET /account/me` prikazuje novi naslov kot `pendingEmail`. Nova zahteva nadomesti čakajočo; sprememba ali ponastavitev gesla jo prekliče. Na posamezni novi naslov se pošlje največ ena povezava na vsakih 5 minut, ne glede na to, kdo jo zahteva (zahteva za spremembo, ki že čaka, ohrani prej poslano povezavo, ki ostane veljavna); odgovor je enak. Trenutni naslov prejme obvestilo, da je bila zahtevana sprememba na zakrit naslov (`a***@example.org`). Odgovor in `pendingEmail` sta enaka tudi, kadar novi naslov že uporablja drug račun: takrat se povezava ne pošlje, zato se ta sprememba nikoli ne dokonča, lastnik tega naslova pa namesto tega prejme obvestilo (največ eno na uro).

Ko je povezava potrjena, se naslov spremeni in velja za potrjenega, naprave ostanejo prijavljene, prej poslane povezave (potrditev, ponastavitev gesla, druge spremembe) prenehajo delovati, prejšnji naslov pa prejme obvestilo, v katerem je novi naslov zakrit.

**Brez potrditve e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): naslov se spremeni takoj (200 `email_changed`), prejšnji naslov pa prejme obvestilo. Če naslov uporablja drug račun, je odgovor 409 `email_taken`, lastnik tega naslova pa prejme obvestilo.

**Ponovno preverjanje pristnosti:** geslo in pri dvofaktorskem preverjanju pristnosti še koda iz aplikacije ali obnovitvena koda. `invalid_email` in `same_email` se preverita pred geslom, zato se ne štejeta kot neuspeh. **Omejitve:** `reauth`, nato `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.en:
Everything the server keeps about the account, as one JSON file to save (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). The export records a security event (`account_exported`). The `notes` array of the document tells the player in plain English what is left out.

**Never in the export:** the password hash, the two-step verification secret and the recovery codes; any session or link token, or a hash of one; the anti-cheat's data (integrity level and score, anomalies, the analysis of the games, the weight of a report); the reports other players made about the player; the identities of moderators; other players' private data (opponents appear by their public name and rating, nothing tells whether another player was sanctioned, and no IP address that may be another person's is included).

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `account_export` (5 per hour per player, for the whole server; every attempt counts, failed ones included; checked first), then `reauth` and `reauth_user`. **Time limit:** 60 seconds.
/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.text:

**Nikoli v izvozu:** zgoščena vrednost gesla, skrivni ključ dvofaktorskega preverjanja pristnosti in obnovitvene kode; kateri koli žeton seje ali povezave ali njegova zgoščena vrednost; podatki sistema proti goljufanju (raven in ocena integritete, anomalije, analiza partij, teža prijave kršitve); prijave kršitev, ki so jih o igralcu vložili drugi igralci; identitete moderatorjev; zasebni podatki drugih igralcev (nasprotniki so navedeni z javnim imenom in ratingom, nič ne razkriva, ali je bil kateri drug igralec sankcioniran, in ni vključen noben naslov IP, ki bi lahko pripadal drugi osebi).

Deletes the account; this cannot be undone.

- These are erased: the e-mail address, the password hash, the two-step secret and recovery codes, the sessions and link tokens, the Google link, the anti-cheat's integrity record, and the IP addresses stored with security events.
- Ratings and games are kept. Games stay readable under the anonymous name, and `GET /players/{username}` answers 404 for the former name.

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/summary.en: Download a game as a PGN file

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.en:
The same game as a PGN file: one game with `\n` line endings, and move text in lines under 80 columns. The answer is the same with or without a token.

Tags, in this order: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` or `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (the UTC start date), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` for an aborted game), `UTCDate` and `UTCTime` (the start), `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` (the ratings at the start, or `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` and `BlackRatingDiff` (the changes, such as `+10` and `-10`, in every rated game, `+0` when the rating rules leave the rating where it was; a casual, custom or aborted game has neither), `TimeControl` (in seconds), `Termination` (a PGN standard value: `normal`; `time forfeit`, a flag fall, also when it ends in a draw; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, a second illegal move or a fair-play forfeit; `unterminated`, an aborted game), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (the decimal id).

Each move carries `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: the mover's clock after the move and the time charged for it, in tenths of a second (truncated). A value is left out when the record lacks it. After the last move, the end reason follows in words, then the result.

**Limit:** `public_read` (per player with a token, per client without).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.text:
Ista partija kot datoteka PGN: ena partija s konci vrstic `\n` in besedilom potez v vrsticah, krajših od 80 stolpcev. Odgovor je enak z žetonom seje ali brez njega.

Oznake v tem vrstnem redu: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` ali `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (datum začetka po UTC), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` za preklicano partijo), `UTCDate` in `UTCTime` (začetek), `WhiteElo` in `BlackElo` (ratinga na začetku ali `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` in `BlackRatingDiff` (spremembi, na primer `+10` in `-10`, v vsaki partiji za rating, `+0`, kadar pravila ratinga pustijo rating nespremenjen; prijateljska partija, partija s tempom igre po meri ali preklicana partija nima nobene od njiju), `TimeControl` (v sekundah), `Termination` (standardna vrednost PGN: `normal`; `time forfeit`, padec zastavice, tudi kadar se partija konča z remijem; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, druga nepravilna poteza ali poraz zaradi kršitve pravil poštene igre; `unterminated`, preklicana partija), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (desetiški ID).

Vsaka poteza ima `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: uro igralca, ki je potezo odigral, po potezi in čas, obračunan za potezo, v desetinkah sekunde (odrezano). Vrednost je izpuščena, kadar je zapis nima. Po zadnji potezi sledi razlog za konec partije z besedami, nato rezultat.

**Omejitev:** `public_read` (po igralcu z žetonom seje, po odjemalcu brez njega).

/paths/~1gif/post/summary.en: Make an animated GIF of any game sent as PGN
/paths/~1gif/post/summary.text: Izdelava animiranega GIF-a poljubne partije, poslane kot PGN

/paths/~1gif/post/description.en:
The same picture as `GET /games/{id}/gif` for any game sent as PGN text: a game saved by the game, an export of another site, a game typed by hand. Only the first game of the text is used.

- The PGN reader takes what the game's own reader takes: every PGN that this server writes and the usual exports of other sites (comments, variations, NAGs and clock annotations are skipped; move numbers and SAN read leniently; a `FEN` tag gives the start position unless `SetUp` is `"0"`).
- The names and ratings come from the `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` tags. Accented letters lose their accents, other characters outside printable ASCII become `?`, and long names are cut (48 characters). The result comes from the `Result` tag, else from the end of the move text. The `Termination` tag is shown unless it is `normal`: the final position then tells the story (checkmate, stalemate).
- This endpoint checks its body itself: an unknown field or a missing or non-string `pgn` answers 400 `invalid_request` with `field`; a wrong option answers 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` must be a JSON number, `coords` a boolean; `null` is refused).

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** as for `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Body limit:** 135,168 bytes, whatever `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (the PGN as a JSON string, its escapes included). **Time limit:** 45 seconds by default.
/paths/~1gif/post/description.text:
Enaka slika kot pri `GET /games/{id}/gif` za poljubno partijo, poslano kot besedilo PGN: partijo, ki jo je shranila igra, izvoz z drugega spletnega mesta, ročno vneseno partijo. Uporabi se samo prva partija v besedilu.

- Bralnik PGN sprejme, kar sprejme bralnik same igre: vsak PGN, ki ga zapiše ta strežnik, in običajne izvoze drugih spletnih mest (komentarji, variante, NAG-i in zapisi ure se preskočijo; številke potez in SAN se berejo prizanesljivo; oznaka `FEN` določa začetno pozicijo, razen če je `SetUp` enak `"0"`).
- Imena in ratingi se vzamejo iz oznak `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` in `BlackElo`. Črke z diakritičnimi znamenji jih izgubijo, drugi znaki zunaj natisljivega ASCII postanejo `?`, dolga imena pa se skrajšajo (48 znakov). Rezultat se vzame iz oznake `Result`, sicer s konca besedila potez. Oznaka `Termination` se prikaže, razen če je `normal`: takrat končna pozicija sama pove, kako se je partija končala (mat, pat).
- Ta končna točka sama preveri svoje telo: na neznano polje ali na `pgn`, ki manjka ali ni niz, odgovori s 400 `invalid_request` z `field`; na napačno možnost odgovori s 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` mora biti število JSON, `coords` logična vrednost; `null` je zavrnjen).

**Potrebna je seja:** kvote se štejejo po računih. **Omejitve:** kot pri `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Omejitev velikosti telesa:** 135.168 bajtov ne glede na `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (PGN kot niz JSON, vključno z ubežnimi zaporedji). **Časovna omejitev:** privzeto 45 sekund.

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/summary.en: Get the top players of a category

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/description.en:
The top 100 rated records of an official category with at least `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) counted games, deleted accounts and confirmed cheaters left out. The server computes each board again at most every 10 seconds; `updatedAt` says when. Strežnik vsako lestvico znova izračuna največ na vsakih 10 sekund; `updatedAt` pove, kdaj. Za posamezno kategorijo hkrati teče samo en izračun: medtem druge zahteve dobijo prejšnji seznam ali pa počakajo na izračun, če seznama še ni.

/paths/~1reports/post/summary.en: Report the opponent of a recent game

/paths/~1reports/post/description.en:
Reports the opponent of one of the player's own games that ended within the last 7 days. A report never changes a rating, a sanction or an integrity level by itself. It raises the review priority that moderators see, and, except for `abuse`, it asks for the engine analysis of the game.

A report of the same opponent for the same game gets the same answer and changes nothing; the answer never tells anything about the reported account. `GET /games/{id}` tells the game's players beforehand whether a report would be taken (`reportable`).

This endpoint checks its body itself, in the order `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: a failure answers 400 `invalid_request` without `field`. Fields it does not know are ignored.

**Limits:** `reports` (per player), then `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) reports per player in 24 hours (429 `report_limit`).
/paths/~1reports/post/description.text:
Prijavi nasprotnika iz ene od igralčevih lastnih partij, ki se je končala v zadnjih 7 dneh. Prijava kršitve sama po sebi nikoli ne spremeni ratinga, sankcije ali ravni integritete. Zviša prioriteto pregleda, ki jo vidijo moderatorji, in razen pri `abuse` zahteva analizo partije s šahovskim programom.

Prijava istega nasprotnika za isto partijo dobi enak odgovor in ničesar ne spremeni; odgovor nikoli ne razkrije ničesar o računu, zoper katerega je bila vložena prijava. `GET /games/{id}` igralcema partije vnaprej pove, ali bi bila prijava sprejeta (`reportable`).

Ta končna točka sama preveri svoje telo, v vrstnem redu `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: ob neuspehu odgovori s 400 `invalid_request` brez `field`. Polja, ki jih ne pozna, prezre.

**Omejitve:** `reports` (po igralcu), nato `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) prijav kršitev na igralca v 24 urah (429 `report_limit`).

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.en: `report_not_allowed`: not the opponent of the reporter in a game that ended within the last 7 days.
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.text: `report_not_allowed`: ni nasprotnik prijavitelja v partiji, ki se je končala v zadnjih 7 dneh.

Stran povezave za potrditev e-poštnega naslova (registracija ali ponovno poslano e-poštno sporočilo za potrditev). Prikaže samo gumb »Confirm my e-mail address« (Potrdi moj e-poštni naslov), da povezave ne porabi pregledovalnik e-pošte, ki jo odpre; gumb pošlje obrazec na `POST /verify-email`.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.en:
The form of the reset page; it does what `POST /auth/password/reset` does, in one transaction: every device is signed out, a pending e-mail change is cancelled, the other reset links stop working, the address counts as confirmed and the owner gets a mail.

The link is checked first, then that both passwords are the same, then the password rules. When the server is busy, the form comes back with `Retry-After` and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (shared with `POST /auth/password/reset`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.text:

Najprej se preveri povezava, nato, ali sta gesli enaki, nato pravila za gesla. Kadar je strežnik zaseden, se obrazec vrne z `Retry-After`, povezava pa ostane veljavna.

**Omejitve:** `auth`, nato `auth_reset` (deljena s `POST /auth/password/reset`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.en: The `auth` or `auth_reset` limit (an HTML page), the form again with `Retry-After` when this client has too many password hashes waiting (the link stays valid), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.text: Omejitev `auth` ali `auth_reset` (stran HTML), znova obrazec z `Retry-After`, kadar ima ta odjemalec v čakalni vrsti preveč zgoščevanj gesel (povezava ostane veljavna), ali sloj po naslovu (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/5.en: The form again with `Retry-After` when the server is busy (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked); the link stays valid. /paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/descri.text:
Stran povezave za spremembo e-poštnega naslova: prikaže novi naslov in ime računa ter gumb »Use this e-mail address« (Uporabi ta e-poštni naslov), ki pošlje obrazec na `POST /confirm-email-change`.

**Omejitev:** `page`.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The page with the new address and its confirmation button.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Stran z novim naslovom in gumbom za njegovo potrditev.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The link is invalid or expired (also when the account's address changed since the request).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Povezava je neveljavna ali potekla (tudi kadar se je naslov računa od zahteve spremenil).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The `page` limit (an HTML page), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Omejitev `page` (stran HTML) ali sloj po naslovu (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/descr.en:
The form of the e-mail change page. The address changes and counts as confirmed; the devices stay signed in; the links sent earlier (confirmation, password reset, other changes) stop working; the former address is told, with the new one masked.

**Limit:** `auth`.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/descr.text:
Obrazec strani za spremembo e-poštnega naslova. Naslov se spremeni in velja za potrjenega; naprave ostanejo prijavljene; prej poslane povezave (potrditev, ponastavitev gesla, druge spremembe) prenehajo delovati; prejšnji naslov prejme obvestilo, v katerem je novi naslov zakrit.

**Omejitev:** `auth`.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The link is invalid, used or expired, or the form is invalid (an HTML page).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Povezava je neveljavna, že uporabljena ali potekla ali pa je obrazec neveljaven (stran HTML).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: Another account took the address in the meantime (an HTML page).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Naslov je medtem prevzel drug račun (stran HTML).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The `auth` limit (an HTML page), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Omejitev `auth` (stran HTML) ali sloj po naslovu (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The database stayed locked (`Retry-After: 1`), or the server is far behind (`Retry-After` 2 to 5, see the introduction): nothing changed and the link still works. Also the handler timeout.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena (`Retry-After: 1`) ali pa strežnik močno zaostaja (`Retry-After` od 2 do 5, glejte uvod): nič ni bilo spremenjeno in povezava še vedno deluje. Tudi potek časa za obdelavo zahteve.

/paths/~1healthz/servers/0/description.en: The official server, at the root.

/paths/~1healthz/servers/2/description.en: Any Scacelith server, at the root.
/paths/~1healthz/servers/2/description.text: Kateri koli strežnik Scacelith, v korenu.

/paths/~1healthz/get/description.en:
Answers 200 `ok` while the process runs. `HEAD` works too. Any other method answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` (`OPTIONS` included).

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1healthz/get/description.text:
Odgovori z 200 `ok`, dokler proces teče. Deluje tudi `HEAD`. Na vse druge metode odgovori s 405 `method_not_allowed` z `Allow: GET, HEAD` (tudi na `OPTIONS`).

**Omejitve:** samo sloj po naslovu.

/paths/~1readyz/servers/0/description.en: The official server, at the root.

/paths/~1readyz/servers/2/description.en: Any Scacelith server, at the root.
/paths/~1readyz/servers/2/description.text: Kateri koli strežnik Scacelith, v korenu.

/paths/~1readyz/get/summary.en: Check that the server accepts players

/paths/~1readyz/get/description.en:
Answers 200 `ready` when the server accepts players, and 503 `not_ready` while it starts or stops. `HEAD` works too. Any other method answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` (`OPTIONS` included).

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1readyz/get/description.text:
Odgovori z 200 `ready`, kadar strežnik sprejema igralce, in s 503 `not_ready`, dokler se zaganja ali ustavlja. Deluje tudi `HEAD`. Na vse druge metode odgovori s 405 `method_not_allowed` z `Allow: GET, HEAD` (tudi na `OPTIONS`).

**Omejitve:** samo sloj po naslovu.

/paths/~1readyz/get/responses/503/descri.en: The server is starting or stopping.

/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.en: A session token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) from a sign-in answer, in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The prefix is exactly `Bearer` (case-sensitive) and one space; a value that does not have it, or a token that is not 1 to 512 printable ASCII characters, answers 401 `invalid_token` like any other invalid token. An empty header counts as no header.
/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.text: Žeton seje (`sct_`, ki mu sledi 43 znakov base64url) iz odgovora na prijavo, v glavi `Authorization`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Predpona je natanko `Bearer` (razlikujejo se velike in male črke) in en presledek; na vrednost brez nje ali na žeton, ki nima od 1 do 512 natisljivih znakov ASCII, je odgovor 401 `invalid_token` kot pri vsakem drugem neveljavnem žetonu. Prazna glava velja, kot da glave ni.

/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.en: The game id, a positive decimal integer of at most 16 digits without leading zeros, below 2^53.
/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.text: ID partije, pozitivno desetiško celo število z največ 16 števkami brez vodilnih ničel, manjše od 2^53.

/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.en: The session id, as `GET /auth/sessions` gives it, written without leading zeros (`03` is not session 3).
/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.text: ID seje, kot ga vrne `GET /auth/sessions`, zapisan brez vodilnih ničel (`03` ni seja 3).

/components/parameters/Username/descript.en: The player's user name, without regard to case. The server takes any name that is 2 to 24 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (the widest rule it ever allowed).
/components/parameters/Username/descript.text: Uporabniško ime igralca, ne glede na velike in male črke. Strežnik sprejme vsako ime, dolgo od 2 do 24 znakov iz `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (najširše pravilo, ki ga je kdaj dovoljeval).

/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.en: A game id; only older games are listed. Pass the previous page's `next`. An empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.text: ID partije; navedene so samo starejše partije. Pošljite `next` prejšnje strani. Prazna vrednost velja za izpuščeno.

/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.en: The page size, 1 to 50. A larger number of up to 3 digits counts as 50; an empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.text: Velikost strani, od 1 do 50. Večje število z največ 3 števkami šteje kot 50; prazna vrednost velja za izpuščeno.

/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.en: The token of the e-mail link (43 base64url characters). A missing or wrong one shows the "link invalid or expired" page.
/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.text: Žeton povezave iz e-poštnega sporočila (43 znakov base64url). Če manjka ali je napačen, se prikaže stran »link invalid or expired« (povezava je neveljavna ali potekla).

/components/headers/CacheControl/descrip.en: Every answer of the server forbids caching.

/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.en: Seconds to wait before trying again; the same value as `retryAfter` in the body.
/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.text: Število sekund, ki jih je treba počakati pred ponovnim poskusom; enaka vrednost kot `retryAfter` v telesu.

/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.en: The bearer challenge, with `error="invalid_token"` for an invalid token.
/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.text: Izziv sheme Bearer, z `error="invalid_token"` pri neveljavnem žetonu.

/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.en: The server closes the connection after this answer.
/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.text: Strežnik po tem odgovoru zapre povezavo.

/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.en: `invalid_request` (with `field` when a field of the body is at fault) or `invalid_json`.
/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.text: `invalid_request` (z `field`, kadar je napaka v polju telesa) ali `invalid_json`.

/components/responses/BadRequest/content.en: A PGN that cannot be read
/components/responses/BadRequest/content.text: PGN, ki ga ni mogoče prebrati

/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.en: `unauthorized` (no `Authorization` header) or `invalid_token` (the token is malformed, expired, revoked, or belongs to a deleted account).
/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.text: `unauthorized` (brez glave `Authorization`) ali `invalid_token` (žeton je napačno oblikovan, potekel, preklican ali pripada izbrisanemu računu).

/components/responses/Forbidden/content/.text: Napačno geslo pri ponovnem preverjanju pristnosti

/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.en: `not_found`, or a feature that this server turned off.
/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.text: `not_found` ali funkcija, ki jo je ta strežnik izklopil.

/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.en: `request_timeout`: the body did not arrive within 10 seconds. The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.text: `request_timeout`: telo ni prispelo v 10 sekundah. Strežnik zapre povezavo.

/components/responses/Conflict/descripti.en: The request conflicts with the state of the server.
/components/responses/Conflict/descripti.text: Zahteva je v sporu s stanjem strežnika.

/components/responses/Gone/description.en: `sso_expired`: the Google sign-in attempt or ticket is unknown, used or expired; start the sign-in again.
/components/responses/Gone/description.text: `sso_expired`: neznan, že uporabljen ali potekel poskus prijave z Googlom ali vstopnica; znova začnite prijavo.

/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.en: `payload_too_large`: the body exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (16,384 bytes by default). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.text: `payload_too_large`: telo presega `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (privzeto 16.384 bajtov). Strežnik zapre povezavo.

/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.en: `unsupported_media_type`: the body is not `application/json`, or its charset is not UTF-8.
/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.text: `unsupported_media_type`: telo ni `application/json` ali pa njegov nabor znakov ni UTF-8.

/components/responses/UnprocessableConte.en: `game_too_long`: the game has more than `GIF_MAX_PLIES` (600) half-moves.

/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.en: `pow_required`: solve the `pow` challenge and send the same request again with `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` says why: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.
/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.text: `pow_required`: rešite izziv `pow` in isto zahtevo pošljite znova s `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` pove, zakaj: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` ali `replayed`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.en: `rate_limited` (a rate limit, the account budget, or the password hash queue) or `too_many_attempts` (a throttle of the account), with `retryAfter` and a `Retry-After` header.
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.text: `rate_limited` (omejitev števila zahtev, kvota računa ali čakalna vrsta za zgoščevanje gesel) ali `too_many_attempts` (omejitev na ravni računa), z `retryAfter` in glavo `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.en: Too many failures on this account
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.text: Preveč neuspelih poskusov na tem računu

/components/responses/InternalError/desc.en: `internal_error`: an unexpected failure. The server logs it.
/components/responses/InternalError/desc.text: `internal_error`: nepričakovana napaka. Strežnik jo zabeleži v dnevnik.

/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.en: `sso_failed`: a wrong `state` or `iss`, or Google refused the code or sent an ID token that does not verify (a code or ID token of the other client, the game's or the website's, included). It never carries Google's text.
/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.text: `sso_failed`: napačen `state` ali `iss` ali pa je Google zavrnil kodo ali poslal žeton ID, ki ne prestane preverjanja (vključno s kodo ali žetonom ID drugega odjemalca, igre ali spletnega mesta). Nikoli ne vsebuje Googlovega besedila.

/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.en: `server_busy`, `busy` or `timeout`: try again after `retryAfter` when it is given.
/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.text: `server_busy`, `busy` ali `timeout`: poskusite znova po `retryAfter`, kadar je naveden.

/components/responses/GifFile/descriptio.en: The animated GIF, as an attachment.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` for a game of this server, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` for a PGN sent with `POST /gif`.
/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.text: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` za partijo s tega strežnika, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` za PGN, poslan s `POST /gif`.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: The size of the file in bytes.

/components/responses/HtmlBadRequest/des.en: An HTML page that explains the refusal.

/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.en: The form did not arrive within 10 seconds (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.text: Obrazec ni prispel v 10 sekundah (stran HTML). Strežnik zapre povezavo.

/components/responses/HtmlConflict/descr.en: An HTML page that explains the conflict.

/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.en: The form exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.text: Obrazec presega `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (stran HTML). Strežnik zapre povezavo.

/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.en: The body is neither a form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) nor JSON, or its charset is not UTF-8 (an HTML page).
/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.text: Telo ni niti obrazec (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) niti JSON ali pa njegov nabor znakov ni UTF-8 (stran HTML).

/components/responses/HtmlTooManyRequest.en: A rate limit (an HTML page), with `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.en: An unexpected failure (an HTML page titled "Server error"). The server logs it.
/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.text: Nepričakovana napaka (stran HTML z naslovom »Server error«, tj. napaka strežnika). Strežnik jo zabeleži v dnevnik.

/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.en: The server is busy (the database stayed locked, or the server is far behind; with `Retry-After`) or took too long (an HTML page titled "Server error").
/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.text: Strežnik je zaseden (zbirka podatkov je ostala zaklenjena ali pa strežnik močno zaostaja; z `Retry-After`) ali pa je potreboval preveč časa (stran HTML z naslovom »Server error«, tj. napaka strežnika).

/components/schemas/Error/description.en: The one shape of every error answer of the JSON API.
/components/schemas/Error/description.text: Enotna oblika vseh odgovorov z napako v API-ju JSON.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.en: The `snake_case` error code. A client chooses what to show from it.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.text: Koda napake v obliki `snake_case`. Odjemalec na njeni podlagi izbere, kaj prikaže.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.en: An English sentence, meant for logs and as a fallback.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.text: Angleški stavek, namenjen dnevnikom in kot nadomestilo.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.en: Seconds to wait before trying again, present only on refusals that end with time. The answer then also carries a `Retry-After` header with the same value, except the 503 `busy` of the history, game, player and leaderboard reads.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.text: Število sekund, ki jih je treba počakati pred ponovnim poskusom; prisotno samo pri zavrnitvah, ki s časom minejo. Odgovor ima takrat tudi glavo `Retry-After` z isto vrednostjo, razen pri 503 `busy` branj zgodovine, partije, igralca in lestvice.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.en: The field or query parameter at fault (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option`, and `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` and `invalid_filter` of `GET /account/games`). A nested field is dotted (`pow.nonce`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.text: Polje ali parameter poizvedbe, ki povzroča napako (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option` ter `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` in `invalid_filter` pri `GET /account/games`). Gnezdeno polje je zapisano s piko (`pow.nonce`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.en: Why: the rule a `weak_password` breaks, or why a proof of work was asked for or refused (`pow_required`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.text: Zakaj: pravilo, ki ga krši `weak_password`, ali zakaj je bil dokaz o delu zahtevan ali zavrnjen (`pow_required`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.en: `banned` only: the end of the ban (epoch ms), `null` for a permanent ban.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.text: Samo `banned`: konec blokade (ms od epohe Unix), `null` za trajno blokado.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/lin.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the line of the error, from 1.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/col.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the column of the error, from 1, in characters.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/col.text: Samo `invalid_pgn`: stolpec napake, od 1, v znakih.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The signed challenge, to send back as it is.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Podpisani izziv, ki ga pošljete nazaj nespremenjenega.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The number of leading zero bits that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` must have.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Število vodilnih ničelnih bitov, ki jih mora imeti `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)`.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: When the challenge expires (epoch ms), 2 minutes after it was issued.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Čas poteka izziva (ms od epohe Unix), 2 minuti po izdaji.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/descriptio.en: The answer to a proof-of-work challenge.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/descriptio.text: Odgovor na izziv dokaza o delu.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.en: The `challenge` of the 428 answer, as it was given.
A decimal string of at most 20 digits such that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` starts with `bits` zero bits.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.text: Desetiški niz z največ 20 števkami, tak, da se `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` začne z `bits` ničelnimi biti.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.en: What a client needs before it signs in or connects.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.text: Kar odjemalec potrebuje, preden se prijavi ali poveže.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The server's name (`SERVER_NAME`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ime strežnika (`SERVER_NAME`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: A UUID that the database gets on its first start. It stays the same across restarts. It is `null` when the database cannot give it.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: UUID, ki ga zbirka podatkov dobi ob prvem zagonu. Ob ponovnih zagonih ostane enak. Je `null`, kadar ga zbirka podatkov ne more podati.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The message of the day (`SERVER_MOTD`), possibly empty.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Sporočilo dneva (`SERVER_MOTD`), lahko prazno.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The WebSocket protocol (`PROTOCOL.md`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Protokol WebSocket (`PROTOCOL.md`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The oldest protocol version the server speaks.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Najstarejša različica protokola, ki jo strežnik podpira.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The newest protocol version the server speaks.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Najnovejša različica protokola, ki jo strežnik podpira.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The fingerprint of the protocol schema (first 4 bytes of the SHA-256 of its canonical form, as an unsigned integer: `0xc649140f`, 3326678031, for protocol minor 2); informational, never compared.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Prstni odtis sheme protokola (prvi 4 bajti SHA-256 njene kanonične oblike kot nepredznačeno celo število: `0xc649140f`, 3326678031, za podrazličico protokola 2); samo informativno, nikoli se ne primerja.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The WebSocket subprotocol token (`Sec-WebSocket-Protocol`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Identifikator podprotokola WebSocket (`Sec-WebSocket-Protocol`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The WebSocket port that players use (`PUBLIC_WS_PORT`, else `WS_PORT`, else `API_PORT`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Vrata WebSocket, ki jih uporabljajo igralci (`PUBLIC_WS_PORT`, sicer `WS_PORT`, sicer `API_PORT`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The path of the WebSocket.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Pot WebSocketa.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Whether new accounts can be created.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ali je mogoče ustvarjati nove račune.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Whether new accounts confirm their address (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ali novi računi potrjujejo svoj naslov (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Whether Google sign-in is offered to the game.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ali je prijava z Googlom na voljo igri.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Whether Google sign-in is offered to a website too (`POST /auth/sso/google/web/start`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ali je prijava z Googlom na voljo tudi spletnemu mestu (`POST /auth/sso/google/web/start`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Two-step verification is always available.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Dvofaktorsko preverjanje pristnosti je vedno na voljo.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The proof-of-work bits that registration needs (0 for none).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Biti dokaza o delu, ki jih zahteva registracija (0, če dokaz ni potreben).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The official (rated) time controls (`RATED_CATEGORIES`), in the server's order. Any other time control is `custom`.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Uradni tempi igre, tj. tisti za rating (`RATED_CATEGORIES`), v vrstnem redu strežnika. Vsak drug tempo igre je `custom`.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The rules a client can check before it sends a form.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Pravila, ki jih odjemalec lahko preveri, preden pošlje obrazec.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The shortest user name (`USERNAME_MIN`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Najmanjša dolžina uporabniškega imena (`USERNAME_MIN`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The longest user name (`USERNAME_MAX`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Največja dolžina uporabniškega imena (`USERNAME_MAX`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The regular expression a new user name must match.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Regularni izraz, ki mu mora ustrezati novo uporabniško ime.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The shortest password, in characters (`PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH`).

/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.en:
A security event. `ip` is given only for what was done while signed in, with the account's password (and second factor) or with a link mailed to its address: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` and `account_exported`; every other kind has `ip: null`, and `ip` is erased after `RETENTION_IP_DAYS`.

`detail` keeps only these fields: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` and `method` (`password`, or `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` and `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. A `moderator_action` event keeps only `{ action }`, for the actions `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` and `revoke_sessions` (the other moderator actions are left out). Every other kind has `detail: null`. The `rating_refund` events are left out: their points are in `ratingRefunds`.
/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.text:
Varnostni dogodek. `ip` je naveden samo za dejanja, opravljena v prijavljenem stanju, z geslom računa (in drugim faktorjem) ali s povezavo, poslano na njegov naslov: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` in `account_exported`; vse druge vrste imajo `ip: null`, `ip` pa se izbriše po `RETENTION_IP_DAYS` dneh.

`detail` ohrani samo ta polja: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` in `method` (`password` ali `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` in `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. Dogodek `moderator_action` ohrani samo `{ action }`, za dejanja `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` in `revoke_sessions` (druga dejanja moderatorjev so izpuščena). Vse druge vrste imajo `detail: null`. Dogodki `rating_refund` so izpuščeni: njihove točke so v `ratingRefunds`.
